'use client'

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react'
import {
  Calendar as CalendarIcon,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Palmtree,
  X,
  Sparkles,
  Clock,
  ShieldCheck,
  Ban,
  CheckCircle2,
  ExternalLink,
  BookOpen,
  Info
} from 'lucide-react'
import {
  getBsMonthCalendar,
  BsCalendarDay,
  NEPALI_MONTHS_EN,
  NEPALI_MONTHS_NP,
  toNepaliDigits,
  getNepaliDate,
  getNepalDateStr
} from '@/lib/nepali-date'
import { DEFAULT_HOLIDAYS, HolidayItem, isDateWithinHoliday } from '@/lib/master-data'
import { useInfrastructureState } from '@/hooks/use-infrastructure-state'
import { useCalendarSettings } from '@/hooks/use-calendar-settings'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'

interface AcademicCalendarModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean
  onClose: () => void
  initialDate?: Date
}

export default function AcademicCalendarModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  initialDate = new Date(),
}: AcademicCalendarModalProps) {
  if (!isOpen) return null

  return <AcademicCalendarModalContent onClose={onClose} initialDate={initialDate} />
}

function AcademicCalendarModalContent({
  onClose,
  initialDate,
}: {
  onClose: () => void
  initialDate: Date
}) {
  const { holidays: customHolidays } = useInfrastructureState()
  const { sundayWeekend, saturdayWeekend } = useCalendarSettings()
  const allHolidays = useMemo(() => {
    const list = [...DEFAULT_HOLIDAYS]
    if (Array.isArray(customHolidays)) {
      customHolidays.forEach((ch) => {
        if (!list.some((h) => h.id === ch.id || h.dateStr === ch.dateStr)) {
          list.push(ch)
        }
      })
    }
    return list
  }, [customHolidays])

  const todayInfo = useMemo(() => getNepaliDate(new Date()), [])
  const [currentBsYear, setCurrentBsYear] = useState<number>(todayInfo.bsYear || 2083)
  const [currentBsMonth, setCurrentBsMonth] = useState<number>(todayInfo.bsMonth || 5)
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'calendar' | 'directory'>('calendar')

  // Selected Day State
  const [selectedDay, setSelectedDay] = useState<BsCalendarDay | null>(null)

  // Current Month Data
  const monthData = useMemo(() => {
    return getBsMonthCalendar(currentBsYear, currentBsMonth)
  }, [currentBsYear, currentBsMonth])

  // Filter holidays for the selected BS Year (Deduplicated by ID)
  const yearHolidays = useMemo(() => {
    const npYearDigits = toNepaliDigits(currentBsYear)
    const enYearStr = currentBsYear.toString()
    const seenIds = new Set<string>()

    return allHolidays
      .filter((h) => {
        if (!h || !h.id || seenIds.has(h.id)) return false
        seenIds.add(h.id)

        if (h.bsDateStr) {
          if (h.bsDateStr.includes(npYearDigits) || h.bsDateStr.includes(enYearStr)) {
            return true
          }
        }
        try {
          const np = getNepaliDate(new Date(h.dateStr))
          return np.bsYear === currentBsYear
        } catch (e) {
          return false
        }
      })
      .sort((a, b) => a.dateStr.localeCompare(b.dateStr))
  }, [allHolidays, currentBsYear])

  // Navigation handlers
  const handlePrevMonth = () => {
    if (currentBsMonth === 1) {
      setCurrentBsYear((y) => y - 1)
      setCurrentBsMonth(12)
    } else {
      setCurrentBsMonth((m) => m - 1)
    }
    setSelectedDay(null)
  }

  const handleNextMonth = () => {
    if (currentBsMonth === 12) {
      setCurrentBsYear((y) => y + 1)
      setCurrentBsMonth(1)
    } else {
      setCurrentBsMonth((m) => m + 1)
    }
    setSelectedDay(null)
  }

  const handleResetToday = () => {
    setCurrentBsYear(todayInfo.bsYear || 2083)
    setCurrentBsMonth(todayInfo.bsMonth || 5)
    setSelectedDay(null)
  }

  const jumpToHolidayMonth = (h: HolidayItem) => {
    const parts = h.dateStr.split('-')
    const adYear = parseInt(parts[0], 10)
    const adMonth = parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1
    const adDay = parseInt(parts[2], 10)
    const d = new Date(Date.UTC(adYear, adMonth, adDay))
    const np = getNepaliDate(d)
    setCurrentBsYear(np.bsYear)
    setCurrentBsMonth(np.bsMonth)
    setActiveTab('calendar')

    const targetDay = monthData.days.find((d) => d.dateStr === h.dateStr)
    if (targetDay) {
      setSelectedDay(targetDay)
    }
  }

  const selectedHoliday = selectedDay
    ? allHolidays.find((h) => isDateWithinHoliday(selectedDay.dateStr, h))
    : null

  const isTodaySelected = selectedDay && selectedDay.dateStr === getNepalDateStr(new Date())

  const isSelectedSaturday = Boolean(selectedDay && selectedDay.dayOfWeek === 6 && saturdayWeekend)
  const isSelectedSunday = Boolean(selectedDay && selectedDay.dayOfWeek === 0 && sundayWeekend)
  const isSelectedWeekend = isSelectedSaturday || isSelectedSunday

  const WEEK_DAYS = useMemo(
    () => [
      { id: 0, labelNp: 'à¤†à¤‡à¤¤', labelEn: 'Sun', isWeekend: sundayWeekend },
      { id: 1, labelNp: 'à¤¸à¥‹à¤®', labelEn: 'Mon' },
      { id: 2, labelNp: 'à¤®à¤‚à¤—à¤²à¤¬à¤¾à¤°', labelEn: 'Tue' },
      { id: 3, labelNp: 'à¤¬à¥à¤§', labelEn: 'Wed' },
      { id: 4, labelNp: 'à¤¬à¤¿à¤¹à¥€', labelEn: 'Thu' },
      { id: 5, labelNp: 'à¤¶à¥à¤•à¥à¤°', labelEn: 'Fri' },
      { id: 6, labelNp: 'à¤¶à¤¨à¤¿', labelEn: 'Sat', isWeekend: saturdayWeekend },
    ],
    [sundayWeekend, saturdayWeekend]
  )

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div
        className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-950/40">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
              <CalendarIcon className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black tracking-tight text-zinc-950 dark:text-white">
                  Academic & National Holidays Calendar
                </h2>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] font-mono border-amber-500/40 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/50">
                  à¤µà¤¿.à¤¸à¤‚. {toNepaliDigits(currentBsYear)} B.S.
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                Official Nepal Government Gazette Holidays, Institutional Holidays & Practical Schedule Status
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white"
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Sub-header Navigation & Tabs */}
        <div className="px-6 py-3 border-b border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800/80 bg-zinc-100/40 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 font-mono text-xs">
          {/* Month Switcher Controls */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handlePrevMonth}
              className="h-8 w-8 p-0 rounded-xl"
              title="Previous Month"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <select
                value={currentBsYear.toString()}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setCurrentBsYear(parseInt(e.target.value, 10))
                  setSelectedDay(null)
                }}
                className="h-8 px-2 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-2xs font-mono"
              >
                {[2080, 2081, 2082, 2083, 2084, 2085].map((y) => (
                  <option key={y} value={y.toString()}>
                    {y} B.S. ({toNepaliDigits(y)})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>

              <div className="px-3 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 shadow-2xs">
                <span className="text-zinc-950 dark:text-white text-sm">
                  {monthData.monthNameNp}
                </span>
                <span className="text-zinc-400 text-[11px]">
                  ({monthData.monthNameEn})
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleNextMonth}
              className="h-8 w-8 p-0 rounded-xl"
              title="Next Month"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>

            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleResetToday}
              className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-xl"
            >
              Current Month
            </Button>
          </div>

          {/* Segmented View Switcher */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-zinc-200/80 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 p-1 rounded-xl">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('calendar')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold text-xs transition-all ${
                activeTab === 'calendar'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-950 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Month View
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('directory')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeTab === 'directory'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-950 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Palmtree className="h-3 w-3 text-amber-500" />
              <span>National Holidays ({allHolidays.length})</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Scrollable Content */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
          {activeTab === 'calendar' ? (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {/* 7-Column Day Header */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 text-center font-mono text-xs font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800/80 pb-2">
                {WEEK_DAYS.map((wd) => (
                  <div
                    key={wd.id}
                    className={`py-1 ${
                      wd.isWeekend ? 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' : ''
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div>{wd.labelNp}</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] font-normal opacity-70">{wd.labelEn}</div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* 7-Column Month Days Grid */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5">
                {/* Empty leading offset cells */}
                {Array.from({ length: monthData.startDayOfWeek }).map((_, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={`blank-${idx}`}
                    className="min-h-[64px] rounded-xl border border-transparent bg-zinc-100/30 dark:bg-zinc-900/20"
                  />
                ))}

                {/* Day Cells */}
                {monthData.days.map((day) => {
                  const isToday = day.dateStr === getNepalDateStr(new Date())
                  const isSaturday = day.dayOfWeek === 6 && saturdayWeekend
                  const isSunday = day.dayOfWeek === 0 && sundayWeekend
                  const isWeekend = isSaturday || isSunday
                  const holiday = allHolidays.find((h) => isDateWithinHoliday(day.dateStr, h))
                  const isSelected = selectedDay?.dateStr === day.dateStr

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={day.dateStr}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setSelectedDay(day)}
                      className={`min-h-[68px] sm:min-h-[76px] p-2 rounded-xl border transition-all flex flex-col justify-between text-left relative group select-none ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'border-indigo-500 ring-2 ring-indigo-500/40 bg-indigo-50/60 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 z-10'
                          : isToday
                          ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 ring-1 ring-emerald-500/50'
                          : holiday
                          ? 'border-amber-400/80 dark:border-amber-600/60 bg-amber-50/40 dark:bg-amber-950/20 hover:bg-amber-50/70'
                          : isWeekend
                          ? 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-100/50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40'
                          : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 hover:border-zinc-400 dark:hover:border-zinc-600'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {/* Top Bar: Nepali Day & English Date */}
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between w-full">
                        <span
                          className={`text-sm sm:text-base font-black font-mono tracking-tight ${
                            isToday
                              ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300'
                              : holiday
                              ? 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300'
                              : isWeekend
                              ? 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400'
                              : 'text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {day.bsDayNp}
                        </span>

                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                          {day.adDayString}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Bottom Status Tags */}
                      <div className="mt-1 w-full truncate">
                        {isToday ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[9px] font-mono font-bold bg-emerald-500 text-white shadow-2xs">
                            TODAY
                          </span>
                        ) : holiday ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[9px] font-mono font-bold bg-amber-500 text-white shadow-2xs truncate max-w-full" title={holiday.name || holiday.title}>
                            <Palmtree className="h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0" />
                            <span className="truncate">{holiday.name || holiday.title}</span>
                          </span>
                        ) : isWeekend ? (
                          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400 font-semibold">
                            Weekend
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  )
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Day Inspector Drawer (When day clicked) */}
              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/70 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 transition-all">
                {selectedDay ? (
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                          Selected Day Details
                        </span>
                        {isTodaySelected && (
                          <Badge className="bg-emerald-500 text-white text-[10px] font-mono">TODAY</Badge>
                        )}
                        {selectedHoliday && (
                          <Badge className="bg-amber-500 text-white text-[10px] font-mono flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Palmtree className="h-3 w-3" />
                            <span>Institutional Holiday</span>
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                        {isSelectedWeekend && !selectedHoliday && (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 text-[10px] font-mono">
                            WEEK OFF
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <h3 className="text-base font-extrabold text-zinc-950 dark:text-white font-mono">
                        {toNepaliDigits(selectedDay.bsYear)} {selectedDay.monthNameNp} {selectedDay.bsDayNp} à¤—à¤¤à¥‡, {selectedDay.dayNameNp}
                        <span className="text-xs font-normal text-zinc-500 ml-2">
                          ({selectedDay.adDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })})
                        </span>
                      </h3>

                      {selectedHoliday ? (
                        <div className="space-y-1 pt-1">
                          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                            {selectedHoliday.titleNp || selectedHoliday.title} ({selectedHoliday.name || selectedHoliday.title})
                          </p>
                          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                            {selectedHoliday.description || 'Official holiday. Regular laboratory practical sessions suspended.'}
                          </p>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-bold">
                            <Ban className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            <span>Practicals Automatically Cancelled â€¢ No Attendance or Skip Logs Created</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : isSelectedWeekend ? (
                        <div className="space-y-1 pt-1">
                          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
                            Institutional Week Off ({selectedDay.dayOfWeek === 6 ? 'Saturday' : 'Sunday'}). Laboratories closed.
                          </p>
                          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                            Official weekly week off. Regular laboratory practical sessions are suspended.
                          </p>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-bold">
                            <Ban className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            <span>Scheduled Week Off â€¢ No Practical Logs Required</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1 text-xs font-mono text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          <span>Standard Academic Working Day â€¢ Normal Laboratory Timetable Operates</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => setSelectedDay(null)}
                      className="shrink-0 text-xs font-mono"
                    >
                      Clear Selection
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono">
                      <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-zinc-400" />
                      <span>Click on any date to inspect holiday status, festival events, and laboratory practical rules.</span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-mono">
                      {yearHolidays.length} Holidays Active in {currentBsYear} B.S.
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* National & Institutional Holidays Directory (View 2) */
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-100 flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <Palmtree className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <div className="text-xs space-y-1">
                    <h4 className="font-bold">Official Government & Institutional Calendar Directory ({currentBsYear} B.S.)</h4>
                    <p className="text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300">
                      On every scheduled holiday listed below, all laboratory practical sessions are <strong>automatically cancelled</strong>. 
                      The system locks slot booking and rejects practical attendance logs (even as skipped) to preserve institutional compliance.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono text-xs border-amber-500/40 bg-white/50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 shrink-0">
                  {yearHolidays.length} Holidays
                </Badge>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                {yearHolidays.map((holiday, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={`${holiday.id}-${idx}`}
                    className="p-4 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 hover:border-amber-400 dark:hover:border-amber-700/60 transition-all shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 group"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <Badge
                          variant="outline"
                          className="text-[10px] font-mono border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-50/60 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300"
                        >
                          {holiday.type.toUpperCase()} HOLIDAY
                        </Badge>

                        <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                          {holiday.bsDateStr || holiday.dateStr}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-950 dark:text-white mt-2">
                        {holiday.titleNp || holiday.title}
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-mono">
                        {holiday.name || holiday.title}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-1">
                        {holiday.description || 'Public institutional holiday. Sessions suspended.'}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="pt-2 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/80 flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
                        <Ban className="h-3 w-3" />
                        <span>Cancelled (No Logs)</span>
                      </div>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => jumpToHolidayMonth(holiday)}
                        className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
                      >
                        <span>View in Grid</span>
                        <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="px-6 py-3 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-950/40 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-zinc-500">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500" />
            <span>Official Holiday Engine Active â€¢ Automatic Holiday Enforcement</span>
          </div>

          <Button
            size="sm"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="h-8 px-4 text-xs font-mono"
          >
            Close Calendar
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import React, { useState } from 'react'
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowRightLeft,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Loader2,
  Users,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'

export interface DisplacedStudent {
  studentName: string
  rollNumber: number
  studentId: string
  enrollmentId: string
  originalWsId?: string
  originalWsLabel?: string
  issueTitle: string
  severity: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical'
  type?: 'faulted' | 'unassigned'
}

interface DisplacedStudentsQueueProps {
  displacedStudents: DisplacedStudent[]
  availableWorkstations: Array<{ id: string; label: string; description?: string }>
  onAssignReplacement: (
    targetWsId: string,
    enrollmentId: string,
    reason: string
  ) => Promise<void>
  onDismiss?: () => void
}

export function DisplacedStudentsQueue({
  displacedStudents,
  availableWorkstations,
  onAssignReplacement,
  onDismiss,
}: DisplacedStudentsQueueProps) {
  const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState(0)
  const [selectedTargets, setSelectedTargets] = useState<Record<string, string>>({})
  const [assigningId, setAssigningId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{ id: string; text: string } | null>(null)
  const [isDismissed, setIsDismissed] = useState(false)

  if (displacedStudents.length === 0 || isDismissed) return null

  const safeIndex = selectedIndex >= displacedStudents.length ? 0 : selectedIndex
  const currentStudent = displacedStudents[safeIndex]

  const handleAssign = async (student: DisplacedStudent) => {
    const validTarget = selectedTargets[student.enrollmentId]
    const targetWsId =
      validTarget && availableWorkstations.some((w) => w.id === validTarget)
        ? validTarget
        : availableWorkstations[0]?.id

    if (!targetWsId) {
      alert('No operational workstations available for relocation.')
      return
    }

    setAssigningId(student.enrollmentId)
    try {
      const isUnassigned = student.type === 'unassigned'
      const reason = isUnassigned
        ? 'Initial seat allocation'
        : `Temporary replacement: ${student.originalWsLabel || 'Station'} unavailable (${student.issueTitle})`

      await onAssignReplacement(targetWsId, student.enrollmentId, reason)
      const targetLabel = availableWorkstations.find((w) => w.id === targetWsId)?.label || targetWsId
      setFeedback({
        id: student.enrollmentId,
        text: `Assigned to ${targetLabel}!`,
      })
      setTimeout(() => {
        setFeedback(null)
      }, 2500)
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || 'Failed to assign replacement seat.')
    } finally {
      setAssigningId(null)
    }
  }

  const isAssigning = assigningId === currentStudent.enrollmentId
  const validSelectedTarget = selectedTargets[currentStudent.enrollmentId]
  const currentTarget =
    validSelectedTarget && availableWorkstations.some((w) => w.id === validSelectedTarget)
      ? validSelectedTarget
      : availableWorkstations[0]?.id || ''
  const currentFeedback = feedback?.id === currentStudent.enrollmentId ? feedback.text : null

  return (
    <div className="h-8 px-3 rounded-lg bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#101726]/95 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/15 shadow-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 text-xs animate-in fade-in duration-150 overflow-hidden">
      {/* Left: Triage Category & Student Selector */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
        {displacedStudents.length > 1 ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
            <span className="flex h-5 items-center gap-1 px-1.5 rounded bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/25 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
              <span>Triage ({displacedStudents.length})</span>
            </span>

            {displacedStudents.length <= 4 ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                {displacedStudents.map((ds, idx) => {
                  const isActive = idx === safeIndex
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={ds.enrollmentId}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setSelectedIndex(idx)}
                      className={`h-5 px-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold rounded transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 ${
                        isActive
                          ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'
                          : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-white/5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-white/10'
                      }`}
                    >
                      R-{ds.rollNumber} {ds.type === 'unassigned' ? 'Â· Unseated' : `Â· ${ds.originalWsLabel}`}
                    </button>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedIndex((prev) => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : displacedStudents.length - 1))}
                  className="h-5 w-5 flex items-center justify-center rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-white/5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  title="Previous student"
                >
                  <ChevronLeft className="h-3 w-3" />
                </button>
                <select
                  value={safeIndex}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedIndex(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="h-5 text-[10px] font-mono bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-white/5 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/10 text-zinc-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded px-1.5 focus:outline-hidden cursor-pointer max-w-[190px] truncate"
                >
                  {displacedStudents.map((ds, idx) => (
                    <option key={ds.enrollmentId} value={idx}>
                      {idx + 1}/{displacedStudents.length}: Roll {ds.rollNumber} ({ds.type === 'unassigned' ? 'Unseated' : ds.originalWsLabel})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedIndex((prev) => (prev < displacedStudents.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : 0))}
                  className="h-5 w-5 flex items-center justify-center rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-white/5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  title="Next student"
                >
                  <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3" />
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <span
            className={`flex h-5 items-center gap-1 px-1.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold shrink-0 ${
              currentStudent.type === 'unassigned'
                ? 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 border border-indigo-200 dark:bg-indigo-500/15 dark:border-indigo-500/30 dark:text-indigo-300'
                : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/15 dark:border-amber-500/30 dark:text-amber-300'
            }`}
          >
            {currentStudent.type === 'unassigned' ? (
              <>
                <Users className="h-2.5 w-2.5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                <span>Unseated</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <AlertTriangle className="h-2.5 w-2.5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                <span>Station Offline</span>
              </>
            )}
          </span>
        )}

        {/* Current Student Details */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 text-xs">
          <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-white/5 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/10 text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300 shrink-0">
            Roll {currentStudent.rollNumber}
          </span>
          <span className="font-heading font-semibold text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-white truncate max-w-[120px] sm:max-w-[160px]">
            {currentStudent.studentName}
          </span>
          <span className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 text-[10px] hidden sm:inline">&bull;</span>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[180px] hidden lg:inline">
            {currentStudent.type === 'unassigned' ? (
              <span className="text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400/90 font-medium">Needs workstation allocation</span>
            ) : (
              <>
                <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-mono font-semibold">{currentStudent.originalWsLabel}: </span>
                <span className="italic text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400">{currentStudent.issueTitle}</span>
              </>
            )}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Right Action: Target Station Dropdown & Action Button */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 ml-auto">
        {availableWorkstations.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <select
              value={currentTarget}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setSelectedTargets((prev) => ({
                  ...prev,
                  [currentStudent.enrollmentId]: e.target.value,
                }))
              }
              className="h-6 text-[11px] font-mono bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#0B0F19] border border-zinc-300 dark:border-white/15 text-zinc-900 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-md px-2 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-indigo-500 cursor-pointer max-w-[170px] sm:max-w-[210px] truncate"
            >
              {availableWorkstations.map((ws) => (
                <option key={ws.id} value={ws.id}>
                  {ws.label} {ws.description ? `Â· ${ws.description}` : 'Â· Available'}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>

            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              disabled={isAssigning || !currentTarget}
              onClick={() => handleAssign(currentStudent)}
              className="h-6 px-2.5 text-[11px] font-bold rounded-md bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white shrink-0 shadow-2xs gap-1 cursor-pointer flex items-center"
            >
              {isAssigning ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Assigning...</span>
                </>
              ) : currentFeedback ? (
                <>
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-400" />
                  <span>{currentFeedback}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <ArrowRightLeft className="h-3 w-3" />
                  <span>{currentStudent.type === 'unassigned' ? 'Assign Station' : 'Relocate'}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </>
        ) : (
          <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-400 italic">No free stations</span>
        )}

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            setIsDismissed(true)
            onDismiss?.()
          }}
          className="p-1 rounded text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors cursor-pointer ml-0.5"
          title="Dismiss triage strip"
        >
          <X className="h-3 w-3" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react'
import {
  Users,
  Search,
  Wand2,
  CheckCircle2,
  GripVertical,
  UserCheck,
  Loader2,
  Sparkles,
} from 'lucide-react'
import type { StudentWithEnrollment } from '@/lib/types/students'

interface StudentTrayProps {
  unassignedStudents: StudentWithEnrollment[]
  selectedStudent: StudentWithEnrollment | null
  onSelectStudent: (student: StudentWithEnrollment | null) => void
  onAutoAssign: () => void
  isAutoAssigning?: boolean
  isPrivileged?: boolean
  className?: string
}

export function StudentTray({
  unassignedStudents,
  selectedStudent,
  onSelectStudent,
  onAutoAssign,
  isAutoAssigning = false,
  isPrivileged = false,
  className = '',
}: StudentTrayProps) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('')

  // Filter students by roll number or name
  const filteredStudents = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return unassignedStudents
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim()
    return unassignedStudents.filter((s) => {
      const matchRoll = String(s.roll_number).includes(q)
      const matchName = s.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      const matchAdm = s.admission_no?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      return matchRoll || matchName || matchAdm
    })
  }, [unassignedStudents, searchQuery])

  return (
    <div
      className={`flex flex-col rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#101726] shadow-xl overflow-hidden text-zinc-900 dark:text-white ${className}`}
    >
      {/* Header Dock */}
      <div className="p-3.5 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32]/60">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
              <Users className="h-4 w-4" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-heading font-extrabold text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                Unassigned Students
              </h3>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {unassignedStudents.length} awaiting seat placement
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <span
            className={`font-mono text-xs font-extrabold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
              unassignedStudents.length > 0
                ? 'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/30 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400'
                : 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-400'
            }`}
          >
            {unassignedStudents.length}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Search Input */}
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-500" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search roll or student name..."
            className="w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#0B0F19] pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-white placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:placeholder-slate-500 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none transition-colors"
          />
          {searchQuery && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
              className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white"
            >
              Clear
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Student List Bay */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto max-h-[380px] sm:max-h-[440px] p-2 space-y-1.5 divide-y divide-zinc-200/60 dark:divide-white/[0.04]">
        {unassignedStudents.length === 0 ? (
          // Meaningful Empty State: All students assigned
          <div className="py-8 px-4 text-center">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/20 mb-2.5">
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">Full Cohort Seated</h4>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
              All enrolled students for this class have an assigned workstation.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : filteredStudents.length === 0 ? (
          // No match for search query
          <div className="py-6 px-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            No unassigned students match &ldquo;{searchQuery}&rdquo;.
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredStudents.map((student) => {
            const isSelected = selectedStudent?.enrollment_id === student.enrollment_id

            return (
              <div
                key={student.enrollment_id}
                draggable={isPrivileged}
                onDragStart={
                  isPrivileged
                    ? (e) => {
                        e.dataTransfer.setData(
                          'application/json',
                          JSON.stringify({
                            type: 'student',
                            enrollment_id: student.enrollment_id,
                            student_name: student.full_name,
                            roll_number: student.roll_number,
                          })
                        )
                      }
                    : undefined
                }
                onClick={isPrivileged ? () => onSelectStudent(isSelected ? null : student) : undefined}
                className={`group flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl border transition-all select-none ${
                  isPrivileged ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'
                } ${
                  isSelected
                    ? 'border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 ring-1 ring-indigo-500/50 shadow-sm'
                    : 'border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.04] bg-zinc-50/80 dark:bg-[#151E32]/40 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-[#151E32] hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-white/[0.08]'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                  {isPrivileged && (
                    <div className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-500 group-hover:text-zinc-700 dark:group-hover:text-slate-300 transition-colors">
                      <GripVertical className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <span className="font-mono text-xs font-extrabold text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-500/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md tabular-nums shrink-0">
                    Roll {student.roll_number}
                  </span>

                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-slate-200 truncate">
                    {student.full_name}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {isPrivileged && (
                  <div className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    {isSelected ? (
                      <span className="font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">Tap PC</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-500 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                        Assign
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          })
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Action Footer: Auto-Assign Remaining (Privileged Only) */}
      {unassignedStudents.length > 0 && isPrivileged && (
        <div className="p-3 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32]/80">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={isAutoAssigning}
            onClick={onAutoAssign}
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-md transition-all disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isAutoAssigning ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                <span>Auto-Assigning...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Wand2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Auto Assign Remaining ({unassignedStudents.length})</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-center mt-1.5 leading-tight">
            Preserves manual seats. Skips decommissioned &amp; critical hardware faults.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {unassignedStudents.length > 0 && !isPrivileged && (
        <div className="p-3 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32]/40 text-center">
          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Read-only session view. Unassigned students are managed by Super Admin or Lab In-Charge.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false)

  // Multi-select state
  const [selectedEnrollmentIds, setSelectedEnrollmentIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())

  // Edit modal state
  const [isEditModalOpen, setIsEditModalOpen] = useState(false)
  const [editTargetStudent, setEditTargetStudent] = useState<StudentWithEnrollment | null>(null)
  const [editName, setEditName] = useState('')
  const [editRoll, setEditRoll] = useState('')
  const [editAdm, setEditAdm] = useState('')
  const [editReg, setEditReg] = useState('')
  const [editGender, setEditGender] = useState<'male' | 'female' | 'other'>('male')
  const [isSubmittingEdit, setIsSubmittingEdit] = useState(false)
  const [editError, setEditError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Delete modal state
  const [isDeleteDialogOpen, setIsDeleteDialogOpen] = useState(false)
  const [deleteTargetStudent, setDeleteTargetStudent] = useState<StudentWithEnrollment | null>(null)
  const [isSubmittingDelete, setIsSubmittingDelete] = useState(false)
  const [deleteNotice, setDeleteNotice] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Bulk actions state
  const [isBulkActionLoading, setIsBulkActionLoading] = useState(false)
  const [bulkActionNotice, setBulkActionNotice] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const selectedClass = useMemo(
    () => classes.find((c) => c.id === selectedClassId) || classes[0] || { id: selectedClassId, name: selectedClassId },
    [classes, selectedClassId]
  )

  // Fetch academic years and classes dynamically from database on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadInitialMetadata() {
      try {
        const [yearRes, classRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
          getAcademicYears(),
          getClassesAction(),
        ])
        if (yearRes.status === 'fulfilled' && yearRes.value.success && yearRes.value.data && yearRes.value.data.length > 0) {
          setAcademicYears(yearRes.value.data)
          const current = yearRes.value.data.find((y) => y.is_current)
          if (current) setSelectedYearId(current.id)
        }
        if (classRes.status === 'fulfilled' && classRes.value.success && classRes.value.data) {
          setClasses(classRes.value.data)
          if (classRes.value.data.length > 0) {
            setSelectedClassId((prev) => {
              if (classRes.value.data.some((c) => c.id === prev)) return prev
              return classRes.value.data[0].id
            })
            setTransferToClass(classRes.value.data[0].id)
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load classes and academic years:', err)
      } finally {
        setIsClassesLoading(false)
      }
    }
    loadInitialMetadata()
  }, [])

  // Fetch class roster
  const fetchRoster = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true)
    try {
      const res = await getStudentsByClass({
        classId: selectedClassId,
        academicYearId: selectedYearId,
        statusFilter: 'all',
      })
      if (res.success && res.data) {
        setStudents(res.data)
      } else {
        setStudents([])
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load roster:', err)
      setStudents([])
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }, [selectedClassId, selectedYearId])

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchRoster()
  }, [fetchRoster])

  const triggerDataSync = useCallback(() => {
    fetchRoster()
    onDataUpdated?.()
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('student-roster-updated'))
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('infrastructure-updated'))
    }
  }, [fetchRoster, onDataUpdated])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialClasses && initialClasses.length > 0) {
      setClasses(initialClasses)
    }
  }, [initialClasses])

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleRemoteUpdate = () => {
      fetchRoster()
    }
    window.addEventListener('student-roster-updated', handleRemoteUpdate)
    window.addEventListener('infrastructure-updated', handleRemoteUpdate)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('student-roster-updated', handleRemoteUpdate)
      window.removeEventListener('infrastructure-updated', handleRemoteUpdate)
    }
  }, [fetchRoster])

  // Filtered students
  const filteredStudents = useMemo(() => {
    return students.filter((s) => {
      // Status filter
      if (statusFilter === 'active' && s.enrollment_status !== 'active') return false
      if (statusFilter === 'archived' && s.enrollment_status === 'active') return false

      // Search filter
      if (!searchQuery.trim()) return true
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim()
      const matchRoll = s.roll_number.toString().includes(q)
      const matchName = s.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      const matchAdm = s.admission_no?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || false
      const matchReg = s.registration_no?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || false

      return matchRoll || matchName || matchAdm || matchReg
    })
  }, [students, searchQuery, statusFilter])

  // Counts
  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    const total = students.length
    const active = students.filter((s) => s.enrollment_status === 'active').length
    const archived = total - active
    return { total, active, archived }
  }, [students])

  // Handle Add Student Submit
  const handleAddStudent = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setAddError(null)

    const rollNum = parseInt(addRoll.trim(), 10)
    if (!rollNum || rollNum <= 0 || rollNum > 200) {
      setAddError('Roll number must be between 1 and 200.')
      return
    }
    if (!addName.trim()) {
      setAddError('Student full name is required.')
      return
    }

    setIsSubmittingAdd(true)
    try {
      const res = await createStudentWithEnrollment({
        student: {
          full_name: addName.trim(),
          admission_no: addAdm.trim() || undefined,
          registration_no: addReg.trim() || undefined,
        },
        enrollment: {
          academic_year_id: selectedYearId,
          class_id: selectedClassId,
          roll_number: rollNum,
        },
      })

      if (res.success) {
        setIsAddModalOpen(false)
        setAddRoll('')
        setAddName('')
        setAddAdm('')
        setAddReg('')
        triggerDataSync()
      } else {
        setAddError(res.error || 'Failed to add student.')
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setAddError(err?.message || 'Error creating student.')
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingAdd(false)
    }
  }

  // Handle Transfer Student Submit
  const handleTransferStudent = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!transferTargetStudent) return
    setTransferError(null)

    const rollNum = parseInt(transferNewRoll.trim(), 10)
    if (!rollNum || rollNum <= 0 || rollNum > 200) {
      setTransferError('Roll number must be between 1 and 200.')
      return
    }

    setIsSubmittingTransfer(true)
    try {
      const res = await transferStudentEnrollment({
        studentId: transferTargetStudent.student_id,
        fromClassId: selectedClassId,
        toClassId: transferToClass,
        academicYearId: selectedYearId,
        newRollNumber: rollNum,
      })

      if (res.success) {
        setIsTransferModalOpen(false)
        setTransferTargetStudent(null)
        setTransferNewRoll('')
        triggerDataSync()
      } else {
        setTransferError(res.error || 'Failed to transfer student.')
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setTransferError(err?.message || 'Error transferring student.')
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingTransfer(false)
    }
  }

  // Handle Export
  const handleExportRoster = async () => {
    setIsExporting(true)
    try {
      const res = await exportCohortRosterAction({
        academicYearId: selectedYearId,
        classId: selectedClassId,
      })
      if (res.success && res.dataBase64) {
        const link = document.createElement('a')
        link.href = `data:application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet;base64,${res.dataBase64}`
        link.download = res.fileName || 'Class_Roster.xlsx'
        link.click()
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Export failed:', err)
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false)
    }
  }

  // Handle Multi-Select
  const handleToggleSelectAll = () => {
    if (selectedEnrollmentIds.size === filteredStudents.length && filteredStudents.length > 0) {
      setSelectedEnrollmentIds(new Set())
    } else {
      setSelectedEnrollmentIds(new Set(filteredStudents.map((s) => s.enrollment_id)))
    }
  }

  const handleToggleSelectStudent = (enrollmentId: string) => {
    const next = new Set(selectedEnrollmentIds)
    if (next.has(enrollmentId)) {
      next.delete(enrollmentId)
    } else {
      next.add(enrollmentId)
    }
    setSelectedEnrollmentIds(next)
  }

  // Handle Edit Student
  const handleOpenEditModal = (student: StudentWithEnrollment) => {
    setEditTargetStudent(student)
    setEditName(student.full_name)
    setEditRoll(student.roll_number.toString())
    setEditAdm(student.admission_no || '')
    setEditReg(student.registration_no || '')
    setEditGender(student.gender || 'male')
    setEditError(null)
    setIsEditModalOpen(true)
  }

  const handleEditStudentSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!editTargetStudent) return

    const rollNum = parseInt(editRoll, 10)
    if (isNaN(rollNum) || rollNum < 1 || rollNum > 200) {
      setEditError('Roll number must be between 1 and 200.')
      return
    }

    setIsSubmittingEdit(true)
    setEditError(null)
    try {
      const res = await updateStudentDetailsAction({
        studentId: editTargetStudent.student_id,
        enrollmentId: editTargetStudent.enrollment_id,
        fullName: editName.trim(),
        rollNumber: rollNum,
        admissionNo: editAdm.trim() || null,
        registrationNo: editReg.trim() || null,
        gender: editGender,
      })

      if (res.success) {
        setIsEditModalOpen(false)
        setEditTargetStudent(null)
        triggerDataSync()
      } else {
        setEditError(res.error || 'Failed to update student.')
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setEditError(err?.message || 'Error updating student.')
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingEdit(false)
    }
  }

  // Handle Single Delete Student
  const handleOpenDeleteModal = (student: StudentWithEnrollment) => {
    setDeleteTargetStudent(student)
    setDeleteNotice(null)
    setIsDeleteDialogOpen(true)
  }

  const handleConfirmDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteTargetStudent) return
    setIsSubmittingDelete(true)
    setDeleteNotice(null)
    try {
      const res = await deleteStudentEnrollmentAction({
        enrollmentId: deleteTargetStudent.enrollment_id,
        studentId: deleteTargetStudent.student_id,
      })

      if (res.success) {
        setIsDeleteDialogOpen(false)
        setDeleteTargetStudent(null)
        setSelectedEnrollmentIds((prev) => {
          const next = new Set(prev)
          next.delete(deleteTargetStudent.enrollment_id)
          return next
        })
        triggerDataSync()
      } else {
        setDeleteNotice(res.error || 'Failed to delete student.')
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setDeleteNotice(err?.message || 'Error deleting student.')
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingDelete(false)
    }
  }

  // Handle Bulk Archive
  const handleBulkArchive = async () => {
    if (selectedEnrollmentIds.size === 0) return
    setIsBulkActionLoading(true)
    setBulkActionNotice(null)
    try {
      const res = await bulkArchiveStudentsAction(Array.from(selectedEnrollmentIds))
      if (res.success) {
        setSelectedEnrollmentIds(new Set())
        setBulkActionNotice(`Successfully archived ${res.count || 0} student enrollment(s).`)
        triggerDataSync()
      } else {
        setBulkActionNotice(res.error || 'Failed to archive selected students.')
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setBulkActionNotice(err?.message || 'Error executing bulk archive.')
    } finally {
      setIsBulkActionLoading(false)
    }
  }

  // Handle Bulk Delete
  const handleBulkDelete = async () => {
    if (selectedEnrollmentIds.size === 0) return
    setIsBulkActionLoading(true)
    setBulkActionNotice(null)
    try {
      const itemsToDelete = filteredStudents
        .filter((s) => selectedEnrollmentIds.has(s.enrollment_id))
        .map((s) => ({
          enrollmentId: s.enrollment_id,
          studentId: s.student_id,
        }))

      const res = await bulkDeleteStudentsAction(itemsToDelete)
      if (res.success) {
        setSelectedEnrollmentIds(new Set())
        const parts = []
        if (res.deletedCount && res.deletedCount > 0) {
          parts.push(`${res.deletedCount} cleanly deleted`)
        }
        if (res.archivedCount && res.archivedCount > 0) {
          parts.push(`${res.archivedCount} safely archived (had attendance logs)`)
        }
        setBulkActionNotice(`Processed ${parts.join(', ')}.`)
        triggerDataSync()
      } else {
        setBulkActionNotice(res.error || 'Failed to delete selected students.')
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setBulkActionNotice(err?.message || 'Error executing bulk delete.')
    } finally {
      setIsBulkActionLoading(false)
    }
  }

  // Handle single student restore
  const handleRestoreStudent = async (student: StudentWithEnrollment) => {
    setIsBulkActionLoading(true)
    try {
      const res = await restoreStudentEnrollmentAction(student.enrollment_id)
      if (res.success) {
        setBulkActionNotice(
          `Restored ${res.restoredStudentName || student.full_name} to Active!${
            res.newRollNumber ? ` Reassigned to Roll ${res.newRollNumber} to prevent collision.` : ''
          }`
        )
        triggerDataSync()
      } else {
        setBulkActionNotice(res.error || 'Failed to restore student.')
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setBulkActionNotice(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown restore error')
    } finally {
      setIsBulkActionLoading(false)
    }
  }

  // Handle alphabetical A-Z resequencing
  const handleResequenceRolls = async () => {
    setIsResequencing(true)
    try {
      const res = await resequenceClassRollsAlphabeticallyAction({
        classId: selectedClassId,
        academicYearId: selectedYearId,
      })
      if (res.success) {
        setBulkActionNotice(`Successfully resequenced ${res.count} active students alphabetically (Aâ€“Z)!`)
        setIsResequenceConfirmOpen(false)
        triggerDataSync()
      } else {
        setBulkActionNotice(res.error || 'Failed to resequence rolls.')
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setBulkActionNotice(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Resequencing error')
    } finally {
      setIsResequencing(false)
    }
  }

  // Get student initials for avatar fallback (e.g. "Kaustuv Thapa" -> "KT")
  const getInitials = (name: string): string => {
    const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/)
    if (parts.length === 0 || !parts[0]) return 'ST'
    if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()
    return (parts[0][0] + parts[parts.length - 1][0]).toUpperCase()
  }

  // Trigger individual student photo selection
  const handleAvatarClick = (student: StudentWithEnrollment) => {
    if (!isPrivileged) return
    setSinglePhotoStudent(student)
    singlePhotoInputRef.current?.click()
  }

  // Process individual student photo selection
  const handleSinglePhotoSelect = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0]
    if (!file || !singlePhotoStudent) return

    setIsUploadingSinglePhoto(true)
    try {
      const compressed = await compressStudentAvatar(file, 256, 0.75)
      const res = await updateStudentPhotoAction({
        studentId: singlePhotoStudent.student_id,
        photoUrl: compressed.dataUrl,
      })

      if (res.success) {
        setBulkActionNotice(`Successfully updated photo for ${singlePhotoStudent.full_name}!`)
        setStudents((prev) =>
          prev.map((s) =>
            s.student_id === singlePhotoStudent.student_id ? { ...s, photo_url: compressed.dataUrl } : s
          )
        )
        triggerDataSync()
      } else {
        setBulkActionNotice(res.error || 'Failed to update photo.')
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Photo optimization error'
      setBulkActionNotice(msg)
    } finally {
      setIsUploadingSinglePhoto(false)
      setSinglePhotoStudent(null)
      if (singlePhotoInputRef.current) singlePhotoInputRef.current.value = ''
    }
  }

  if (isClassesLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-12 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#101726] text-center space-y-3 font-sans">
        <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin mx-auto text-indigo-500" />
        <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400">Loading student rosters and classes...</p>
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (!isClassesLoading && classes.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="p-8 rounded-2xl border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/5 text-center space-y-4 font-sans text-slate-100">
        <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-6 w-6" />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold font-heading text-white">System Unconfigured</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
            No active classes found in the database. Please add classes in the Admin Dashboard under Curriculum to activate the student roster.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 font-sans text-zinc-900 dark:text-slate-100">
      
      {/* Top Filter and Actions Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-stretch lg:items-center justify-between gap-3 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#101726] shadow-xs sm:shadow-sm">
        
        {/* Left: Academic Year + Class Selectors */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08]">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400">Year:</span>
            <select
              value={selectedYearId}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedYearId(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-transparent text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              {academicYears.length > 0 ? (
                academicYears.map((y) => (
                  <option key={y.id} value={y.id} className="bg-white dark:bg-[#151E32] text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                    {y.name} {y.is_current ? '(Current)' : ''}
                  </option>
                ))
              ) : (
                <option value="2083" className="bg-white dark:bg-[#151E32] text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">2083 B.S. (Current)</option>
              )}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08]">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400">Class:</span>
            <select
              value={selectedClassId}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedClassId(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-transparent text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              {classes.map((c) => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id} className="bg-white dark:bg-[#151E32] text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                  {c.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Segmented Status Filter Tabs: Active | Archived | All */}
          <div className="flex items-center p-1 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-[#151E32] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-xs">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('active')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg font-semibold transition cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                statusFilter === 'active'
                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <span>Active</span>
              <span className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full tabular-nums ${
                statusFilter === 'active' ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-zinc-200/80 dark:bg-white/[0.06] text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400'
              }`}>
                {counts.active}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('archived')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg font-semibold transition cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                statusFilter === 'archived'
                  ? 'bg-amber-600/90 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <span>Archived</span>
              <span className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full tabular-nums ${
                statusFilter === 'archived' ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-zinc-200/80 dark:bg-white/[0.06] text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400'
              }`}>
                {counts.archived}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter('all')}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg font-semibold transition cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                statusFilter === 'all'
                  ? 'bg-slate-700 text-white shadow-xs'
                  : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <span>All</span>
              <span className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full tabular-nums ${
                statusFilter === 'all' ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-zinc-200/80 dark:bg-white/[0.06] text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400'
              }`}>
                {counts.total}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right: Search + Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* Search Box */}
          <div className="relative flex-1 sm:w-52">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by name, roll, admission no..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32] text-zinc-900 dark:text-white placeholder-zinc-400 dark:placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500/50 transition"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Export Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleExportRoster}
            disabled={isExporting}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32] hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300 transition disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isExporting ? <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Export</span>
          </button>

          {/* Privileged Management Buttons */}
          {isPrivileged && (
            <>
              {/* Sort Rolls A-Z Button */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsResequenceConfirmOpen(true)}
                disabled={counts.active === 0}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#151E32] hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white/[0.06] text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                title="Alphabetically sort rolls (Aâ€“Z) for active students"
              >
                <ArrowDownAZ className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                <span className="hidden md:inline">Sort Rolls (Aâ€“Z)</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"

                />

                >
                  {isSubmittingEdit ? (

                      <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />

        </div>
      )}

      {/* Delete / Archive Confirmation Dialog */}
      {isDeleteDialogOpen && deleteTargetStudent && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-rose-500/30 bg-white dark:bg-[#101726] shadow-2xl p-6 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5 text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold font-heading text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                  Remove Student from {selectedClass.name}
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
                className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                âœ•

            <div className="space-y-2 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300">
              <p>
                Are you sure you want to remove <span className="text-zinc-900 dark:text-white font-bold">{deleteTargetStudent.full_name}</span> (Roll {deleteTargetStudent.roll_number})?
              </p>
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200 text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
                <strong>Institutional Audit Rule:</strong> If this student has active practical attendance logs, their enrollment will be safely <strong>archived</strong> rather than erased, preserving past attendance records. If no practical logs exist, the record will be <strong>cleanly deleted</strong>.
              </div>
            </div>

            {deleteNotice && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 text-xs">

              </div>
            )}

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08]">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsDeleteDialogOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl text-zinc-600 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleConfirmDelete}
                disabled={isSubmittingDelete}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white shadow-md transition disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isSubmittingDelete ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    <span>Removing...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
