                    <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>Confirm Remove</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Resequence Rolls A-Z Confirmation Modal */}
      {isResequenceConfirmOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#151E32] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.1] rounded-2xl shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-4 animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <ArrowDownAZ className="h-5 w-5 text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">Resequence Rolls Alphabetically (Aâ€“Z)</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsResequenceConfirmOpen(false)}
                className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                âœ•
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300">
              <p>
                Are you sure you want to sort all <span className="text-zinc-900 dark:text-white font-bold">{counts.active} active students</span> in <span className="text-zinc-900 dark:text-white font-bold">{selectedClass.name}</span> ({selectedYearId} B.S.) alphabetically by full name and renumber their roll numbers sequentially from <strong>1 to {counts.active}</strong>?
              </p>
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/20 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-200 text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
                <strong>Safety Governance Lock:</strong> Roll resequencing is only permitted if <strong>zero practical attendance logs</strong> exist for this class. If logs exist, the operation will be safely rejected to maintain historical compliance.
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08]">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsResequenceConfirmOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl text-zinc-600 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleResequenceRolls}
                disabled={isResequencing}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white shadow-md transition disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isResequencing ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    <span>Sorting...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <ArrowDownAZ className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>Sort & Assign 1..N</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Batch Student Photo Import Modal */}
      <BatchPhotoImportModal
        isOpen={isBatchPhotoModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsBatchPhotoModalOpen(false)}
        onSuccess={() => {
          setBulkActionNotice('Batch student photos successfully updated!')
          triggerDataSync()
        }}
        classNameLabel={selectedClass.name}
        academicYearLabel={selectedYearId}
        students={students.map((s) => ({
          student_id: s.student_id,
          full_name: s.full_name,

      <input
        ref={singlePhotoInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/*"

    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react'
import {
  Upload,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle,
  X,
  Download,
  Loader2,
  ArrowLeft,
  Search,
  UserPlus,
  UserCheck,
  UserMinus,
  Cpu,
  Phone,
  Sparkles,
} from 'lucide-react'
import {
  validateRosterFileAction,
  commitRosterIngestionAction,
  getBlankRosterTemplateAction,
} from '@/app/actions/roster-ingestion'
import type {
  RosterPreflightReport,
  RosterCommitResult,
  ValidationRowPreview,
  IngestionPayloadRow,
  UnmatchedExistingStudent,
} from '@/lib/roster-ingestion/types'

interface RosterImportModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean
  onClose: () => void
  academicYearId: string
  academicYearName: string
  classId: string
  className: string
  onSuccess?: () => void
}

export function RosterImportModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  academicYearId,
  academicYearName,
  classId,
  className,
  onSuccess,
}: RosterImportModalProps) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<'upload' | 'preview' | 'result'>('upload')
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<File | null>(null)
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false)
  const [isValidating, setIsValidating] = useState(false)
  const [isCommitting, setIsCommitting] = useState(false)
  const [isDownloadingTemplate, setIsDownloadingTemplate] = useState(false)
  const [validationReport, setValidationReport] = useState<RosterPreflightReport | null>(null)
  const [commitResult, setCommitResult] = useState<RosterCommitResult | null>(null)
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // Reconciliation settings
  const [keepMissingEnrolled, setKeepMissingEnrolled] = useState(true)
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<'all' | 'new' | 'existing' | 'missing'>('all')
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('')

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  if (!isOpen) return null

  // Handle template download
  const handleDownloadTemplate = async () => {
    setIsDownloadingTemplate(true)
    try {
      const res = await getBlankRosterTemplateAction({
        academicYearId,
        classId,
      })
      if (res.success && res.dataBase64) {
        const link = document.createElement('a')
        link.href = `data:application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet;base64,${res.dataBase64}`
        link.download = res.fileName || 'Class_Roster_Template.xlsx'
        link.click()
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Failed to download template.')
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Error downloading template.'
      setErrorMessage(msg)
    } finally {
      setIsDownloadingTemplate(false)
    }
  }

  // Handle file validation upload
  const processUploadedFile = async (file: File) => {
    setSelectedFile(file)
    setErrorMessage(null)
    setIsValidating(true)

    try {
      const formData = new FormData()
      formData.append('file', file)
      formData.append('academicYearId', academicYearId)
      formData.append('classId', classId)
      formData.append('mode', 'sync')

      const res = await validateRosterFileAction(formData)
      if (res.success && res.report) {
        setValidationReport(res.report)
        setStep('preview')
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Validation failed. Please verify spreadsheet contents.')
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unexpected file validation error.'
      setErrorMessage(msg)
    } finally {
      setIsValidating(false)
    }
  }

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0]
    if (file) processUploadedFile(file)
  }

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setIsDragging(true)
  }

  const handleDragLeave = () => {
    setIsDragging(false)
  }

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setIsDragging(false)
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0]
    if (file) processUploadedFile(file)
  }

  // Handle commit ingestion
  const handleCommit = async () => {
    if (!validationReport) return

    setIsCommitting(true)
    setErrorMessage(null)

    try {
      const payloadRows: IngestionPayloadRow[] = validationReport.rows.map((r) => ({
        roll_number: r.roll_number || 0,
        full_name: r.full_name,
        admission_no: r.admission_no || null,
        registration_no: r.registration_no || null,
        gender: r.gender || null,
        contact: r.contact || null,
        student_id: r.matched_student_id || null,
        action: 'sync',
      }))

      const res = await commitRosterIngestionAction({
        academicYearId,
        classId,
        rows: payloadRows,
        mode: 'sync',
      })

      if (res.success && res.result) {
        setCommitResult(res.result)
        setStep('result')
        onSuccess?.()
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Failed to commit roster to database.')
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unexpected error during commit.'
      setErrorMessage(msg)
    } finally {
      setIsCommitting(false)
    }
  }

  const handleReset = () => {
    setStep('upload')
    setSelectedFile(null)
    setValidationReport(null)
    setCommitResult(null)
    setErrorMessage(null)
    setSearchQuery('')
    setActiveFilter('all')
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = ''
  }

  // Filter rows based on search and active tab
  const rows = validationReport?.rows || []
  const missingStudents: UnmatchedExistingStudent[] =
    validationReport?.buckets.bucket4_unmatched_existing || []

  const newStudents = rows.filter((r) => r.status === 'valid_new')
  const existingStudents = rows.filter(
    (r) => r.status === 'valid_existing' || r.status === 'valid_retained' || r.status === 'valid_roll_update'
  )

  const filteredRows = rows.filter((r) => {
    if (activeFilter === 'new' && r.status !== 'valid_new') return false
    if (
      activeFilter === 'existing' &&
      r.status !== 'valid_existing' &&
      r.status !== 'valid_retained' &&
      r.status !== 'valid_roll_update'
    )
      return false

    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim()
      const matchName = r.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      const matchAdm = (r.admission_no || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      const matchRoll = String(r.roll_number || '').includes(q)
      return matchName || matchAdm || matchRoll
    }
    return true
  })

  const filteredMissing = missingStudents.filter((m) => {
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim()
      return (
        m.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (m.admission_no || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(m.roll_number).includes(q)
      )
    }
    return true
  })

  return (

        {/* Header */}

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/20">
              <FileSpreadsheet className="h-5 w-5" />

                  Universal Ingestion

            </div>

            onClick={onClose}

          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 space-y-5">
          {errorMessage && (

              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400 mt-0.5" />

          {/* STEP 1: UPLOAD */}
          {step === 'upload' && (

interface StudentTerminalViewProps {
  initialData: TerminalContextData
  isSessionAuthenticated?: boolean
}

export function StudentTerminalView({
  initialData,
  isSessionAuthenticated = false,
}: StudentTerminalViewProps) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<TerminalContextData>(initialData)
  const [selectedChip, setSelectedChip] = useState<TerminalIssueChip | null>(null)
  const [customDetails, setCustomDetails] = useState('')
  const [studentName, setStudentName] = useState(data.currentStudent?.studentName || '')
  const [studentRoll, setStudentRoll] = useState(
    data.currentStudent?.rollNumber ? String(data.currentStudent.rollNumber) : ''
  )
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [submitSuccess, setSubmitSuccess] = useState(false)
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [clientPairingToken, setClientPairingToken] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true)
  }, [])

  // Real-time synchronization when time travels, session changes, or workstations update
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true
    let inFlight = false

    const syncTerminalData = async (force: boolean = false) => {
      if (!isMounted || inFlight) return
      // Skip background polling if tab is in the background to prevent server stampedes
      if (!force && typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.hidden) return

      inFlight = true
      try {
        const simTime = getEffectiveDate().getTime()
        const res = await getTerminalContext(
          data.stationCode,
          clientPairingToken || undefined,
          undefined,
          simTime
        )
        if (isMounted && res.success && res.data) {
          setData(res.data)
          if (res.data.currentStudent) {
            setStudentName(res.data.currentStudent.studentName)
            setStudentRoll(String(res.data.currentStudent.rollNumber))
          } else {
            setStudentName('')
            setStudentRoll('')
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to auto-sync terminal context:', err)
      } finally {
        inFlight = false
      }
    }

    // Run initial sync on mount
    syncTerminalData(true)

    // Sync immediately when tab regains focus or visibility
    const handleVisibility = () => {
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && !document.hidden) {
        syncTerminalData(true)
      }
    }
    const handleFocus = () => syncTerminalData(true)
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus)
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility)

    // Targeted real-time events (removed blanket 'storage' event which caused multi-tab stampedes)
    const handleTimeTravel = () => syncTerminalData(true)
    window.addEventListener(TIME_TRAVEL_EVENT, handleTimeTravel)
    const unsubWs = subscribeToSync('workstations', () => syncTerminalData(true))
    const unsubSched = subscribeToSync('schedules', () => syncTerminalData(true))
    
    // Adaptive 15s interval (only active when tab is visible)
    const interval = setInterval(() => syncTerminalData(false), 15000)

    return () => {
      isMounted = false
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus)
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibility)
      window.removeEventListener(TIME_TRAVEL_EVENT, handleTimeTravel)
      unsubWs()
      unsubSched()
      clearInterval(interval)
    }
  }, [data.stationCode, clientPairingToken])

  // Load persistent browser pairing token from localStorage if present (for fallback)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const storedToken =
        localStorage.getItem(`labsync_paired_token_${data.stationCode}`) ||
        localStorage.getItem('labsync_paired_token')
      if (storedToken) {
        setClientPairingToken(storedToken)
      } else if (data.pairingToken) {
        localStorage.setItem(`labsync_paired_token_${data.stationCode}`, data.pairingToken)
        localStorage.setItem('labsync_paired_token', data.pairingToken)
        setClientPairingToken(data.pairingToken)
      }
    }
  }, [data.stationCode, data.pairingToken])

  const handleChipClick = (chip: TerminalIssueChip) => {
    setSelectedChip(chip)
    setErrorMessage(null)
  }

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!selectedChip) {
      setErrorMessage('Please select an issue type to request assistance.')
      return
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true)
    setErrorMessage(null)

    const res = await submitStudentIssueReport({
      stationCode: data.stationCode,
      issueTag: selectedChip.id,
      title: selectedChip.label,
      description: customDetails.trim() || selectedChip.description,
      studentName: studentName.trim() || undefined,
      studentRoll: studentRoll.trim() || undefined,
      pairingToken: clientPairingToken || data.pairingToken || undefined,
    })

    setIsSubmitting(false)

    if (res.success) {
      setSubmitSuccess(true)
      setCustomDetails('')
      setSelectedChip(null)
      broadcastSync('assistance', { stationCode: data.stationCode })
      broadcastSync('workstations', { stationCode: data.stationCode })
    } else {
      setErrorMessage(res.error || 'Failed to submit assistance request.')
    }
  }

  const renderChipIcon = (iconName: string) => {
    switch (iconName) {
      case 'MousePointer':
        return <MousePointer className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" />
      case 'WifiOff':
        return <WifiOff className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />
      case 'PackageX':
        return <PackageX className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-400" />
      case 'ZapOff':
        return <ZapOff className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400 animate-pulse" />
      case 'VolumeX':
        return <VolumeX className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-300" />
      default:
        return <HelpCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-zinc-400" />
    }
  }

  // Only render telemetry strip when mounted on client and genuine hardware properties exist
  const hasHardwareSpecs = Boolean(
    mounted &&
      data.hardwareSpecs &&
      (data.hardwareSpecs.cpu ||
        data.hardwareSpecs.ram_gb ||
        data.hardwareSpecs.disk_c_free_gb ||
        data.hardwareSpecs.lan_ip)
  )
  const specs = data.hardwareSpecs

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0B0F19] text-zinc-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-sans flex flex-col justify-between selection:bg-indigo-500 selection:text-white">
      {/* Top Academic Status Header */}
      <header className="border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white/80 dark:bg-[#101726]/80 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-20 px-4 py-3 sm:px-6">
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500/15 border border-indigo-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-xs">
              <Monitor className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-sm font-heading font-extrabold tracking-wide text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                  {data.labName}
                </span>
                <span className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-600 text-xs">â€¢</span>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] font-mono bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-[#151E32] border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/10 text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                  {data.rowLabel || 'Floor Node'}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400">Student Assistance &amp; Practical Terminal Gateway</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-[#151E32] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-right shadow-xs">
              <div className="text-[9.5px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Terminal Node</div>
              <div className="text-base font-extrabold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono tracking-tight flex items-center gap-1.5 justify-end">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 dark:bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                <span>{data.stationCode}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Main Body */}
      <main className="flex-1 max-w-4xl w-full mx-auto p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-4 sm:space-y-5">
        {/* Hardware Telemetry Strip (If populated by agent) */}
        {hasHardwareSpecs && specs && (
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#101726] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl p-3.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300 shadow-xs sm:shadow-md">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-semibold text-[11px] shadow-xs">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                Silicon Hardware Bound
              </span>
              {specs.cpu ? (
                <span className="text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-mono text-[11px] font-medium">
                  {specs.cpu}{specs.cpu_cores ? ` (${specs.cpu_cores}C)` : ''}
                </span>
              ) : null}
              {specs.ram_gb ? (
                <>
                  <span className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-slate-600 hidden sm:inline">â€¢</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-zinc-900 dark:text-white font-bold">{specs.ram_gb} GB RAM</span>
                </>
              ) : null}
              {specs.disk_c_free_gb ? (
                <>
                  <span className="text-zinc-300 dark:text-slate-600 hidden sm:inline">â€¢</span>
                  <span className="text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Drive C: <strong className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono font-bold">{specs.disk_c_free_gb} GB</strong> free
                  </span>
                </>
              ) : null}
            </div>
            {specs.lan_ip ? (
              <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-white/[0.04] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/5">
                IP: {specs.lan_ip}
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Active Session & Student Recognition Card */}
        <section className="bg-white dark:bg-[#101726] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xs sm:shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden space-y-4">
          <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-64 h-64 bg-indigo-500/5 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.06] pb-4">
            <div>
              <div className="text-xs text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold font-mono flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400" />
                Active Practical Routine
                {data.activeSession?.batchName && (
                  <span className="text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-500 font-normal">â€¢ {data.activeSession.batchName}</span>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="text-lg font-extrabold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white font-heading mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <span>{data.activeSession?.subjectName || 'Open Laboratory Practical Hours'}</span>
                {data.activeSession?.startTime && data.activeSession?.endTime && (
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono font-medium text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-white/[0.05] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
                    {data.activeSession.startTime} â€“ {data.activeSession.endTime}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Today's Practical Experiment Focus */}
              <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0B0F19]/80 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-500/20 rounded-xl p-2.5 flex items-start gap-2 max-w-xl">
                <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <div>
                  <div className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                    {data.activeSession?.practicalTitle || 'Standard Laboratory Practical Syllabus'}
                  </div>
                  {data.activeSession?.topicLearned && (
                    <div className="text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[11px] mt-0.5">
                      Focus: {data.activeSession.topicLearned}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {data.activeSession?.teacherName && (
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
                      Instructor: <span className="text-zinc-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-semibold">{data.activeSession.teacherName}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Status Indicators: Live Countdown & Anti-Spoofing Lock */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap sm:flex-col items-start sm:items-end gap-2 shrink-0">
              {data.activeSession?.remainingMinutes !== undefined ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-500/40 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl shadow-xs font-mono">
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400 animate-pulse" />
                  <span>{data.activeSession.remainingMinutes} min remaining</span>
                </div>
              ) : data.activeSession?.startTime ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl shadow-xs font-mono">
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400" />
                  <span>Starts {data.activeSession.startTime}</span>
                </div>
              ) : null}

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/30 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl shadow-xs font-mono">
                <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                <span>Locked to {data.stationCode}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Student Recognition */}
          <div className="pt-1 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-[#151E32] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-300 overflow-hidden shrink-0 shadow-xs">
                {data.currentStudent?.photoUrl ? (
                  <img
                    src={data.currentStudent.photoUrl}
                    alt={data.currentStudent.studentName}
                    className="h-full w-full object-cover object-top"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <User className="w-5 h-5 text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-400" />
                )}
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                  <span>Enrolled Student</span>
                  {data.currentStudent?.isTemporary && (
                    <Badge className="bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30 text-[9px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0">
                      Temp Relocation {data.currentStudent.originalWorkstationLabel ? `from ${data.currentStudent.originalWorkstationLabel}` : ''}
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">
                  {data.currentStudent ? (
                    <>
                      {data.currentStudent.studentName}{' '}
                      <span className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-mono text-xs">(Roll {data.currentStudent.rollNumber})</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic">No student enrolled for current practical slot</span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Student Name/Roll Confirmation Inputs */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Student Name (optional)"
                value={studentName}
                onChange={(e) => setStudentName(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#0B0F19] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-slate-200 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 w-36 sm:w-44 transition-colors"
              />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Roll #"
                value={studentRoll}
                onChange={(e) => setStudentRoll(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#0B0F19] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-slate-200 placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 w-16 sm:w-20 font-mono transition-colors"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Success Alert Banner */}
        {submitSuccess && (
          <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/50 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200 flex items-start gap-3 shadow-xs sm:shadow-xl animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2 duration-300">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="flex-1">
              <div className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-950 dark:text-white font-heading">Assistance Request Dispatched!</div>
              <div className="text-xs text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300/90 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">
                Your report has been broadcast to the Live Cockpit for <strong className="text-emerald-950 dark:text-white font-mono">{data.stationCode}</strong>.
                The Lab In-Charge and Subject Instructor have received this beacon. Please continue working on other assigned tasks.
              </div>
            </div>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={() => setSubmitSuccess(false)}
              className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-950 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/40 text-xs h-7 px-2.5 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
            >
              Dismiss
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Error Alert Banner */}
        {errorMessage && (
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/50 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200 flex items-start gap-3 shadow-xs sm:shadow-xl">
            <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="flex-1 text-xs">{errorMessage}</div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 1-Tap Quick Issue Chips Section (6 Alive-Only Categories) */}
        <section className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider font-heading flex items-center gap-2">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500 dark:text-indigo-400" />
              Select Problem Category
            </h2>
            <span className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400">1-tap card to alert instructor</span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3.5">
            {TERMINAL_QUICK_ISSUES.map((chip) => {
              const isSelected = selectedChip?.id === chip.id
              return (
                <button
                  key={chip.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleChipClick(chip)}
                  className={`p-4 rounded-2xl text-left transition-all border flex items-start gap-3.5 group relative overflow-hidden cursor-pointer ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 border-indigo-500 shadow-sm dark:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(99,102,241,0.25)] ring-1 ring-indigo-500/50'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-[#101726] border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] hover:border-indigo-300 dark:hover:border-indigo-500/40 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-[#151E32] text-zinc-700 dark:text-slate-300 shadow-xs sm:shadow-md'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl shrink-0 transition-transform group-hover:scale-105 shadow-xs ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-500/25 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300'
                        : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#151E32] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/5'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {renderChipIcon(chip.iconName)}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white font-heading leading-tight group-hover:text-indigo-600 dark:group-hover:text-white">
                        {chip.label}
                      </span>
                      {isSelected && (
                        <span className="h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-500 flex items-center justify-center text-white shrink-0">
                          <Check className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                      {chip.description}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </button>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Custom Details & Submit Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-white dark:bg-[#101726] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-4 shadow-xs sm:shadow-xl">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-slate-200 mb-1.5 font-heading">
              Additional Details or Specific Observations (Optional)
            </label>
            <textarea
              placeholder={
                selectedChip
                  ? `e.g. Details regarding "${selectedChip.label}"...`
                  : 'Describe what is happening on your terminal screen or hardware...'
              }
              value={customDetails}
              onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => setCustomDetails(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-[#0B0F19] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-white placeholder:text-zinc-400 dark:placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:border-indigo-500 p-3.5 min-h-[75px] outline-none transition-colors"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-1">
            <div className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              {selectedChip ? (
                <span>
                  Selected:{' '}
                  <strong className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold">{selectedChip.label}</strong>
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-zinc-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic">No issue selected yet. Tap any problem category above.</span>
              )}
            </div>

            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting || !selectedChip}
              className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold text-xs px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow-lg transition-all disabled:opacity-40 flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer h-10"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Submitting to Cockpit...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Submit Issue Report</span>
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Recent Open Tickets for this Workstation */}
        {data.recentIssues && data.recentIssues.length > 0 && (
          <section className="space-y-2.5 pt-2">
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-heading">
              Active Tickets for {data.stationCode}
            </div>
            <div className="divide-y divide-zinc-200 dark:divide-white/[0.06] bg-white dark:bg-[#101726] border border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-xs sm:shadow-md">
              {data.recentIssues.map((iss) => (
                <div key={iss.id} className="p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <span
                      className={`h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ${
                        iss.severity === 'critical'
                          ? 'bg-rose-500 animate-pulse'
                          : iss.severity === 'high'
                          ? 'bg-amber-500'
                          : 'bg-indigo-500'
                      }`}
                    />
                    <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-900 dark:text-white">{iss.title}</span>
                  </div>
                  <Badge
                    variant="outline"
                    className={`text-[10px] font-mono capitalize ${
                      iss.status === 'in_progress'
                        ? 'border-indigo-500/40 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/20'
                        : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-white/10 text-zinc-600 dark:text-slate-400'
                    }`}
                  >

import { Pool } from 'pg'

declare global {
  var __PG_POOL__: Pool | undefined
}

export function resolveDatabaseUrl(rawUrl?: string): string | undefined {
  if (!rawUrl) return rawUrl
  let url = rawUrl
  if (url.includes('db.') && url.includes('.supabase.co')) {
    const match = url.match(/postgresql:\/\/([^:]+):(.+)@db\.([a-z0-9]+)\.supabase\.co(?::\d+)?\/(.+)$/)
    if (match) {
      const [, , pass, ref, db] = match
      const decodedPass = decodeURIComponent(pass)
      url = `postgresql://postgres.${ref}:${encodeURIComponent(decodedPass)}@aws-0-ap-southeast-1.pooler.supabase.com:6543/${db}`
    }
  }
  // Convert any session mode pooler (port 5432) to transaction mode pooler (port 6543)
  // to avoid connection starvation and ECONNRESET drops under multi-tab load
  if (url.includes('.pooler.supabase.com:5432')) {
    url = url.replace('.pooler.supabase.com:5432', '.pooler.supabase.com:6543')
  }
  return url
}

export function getPgPool(): Pool {
  if (!globalThis.__PG_POOL__) {
    const connectionString = resolveDatabaseUrl(process.env.DATABASE_URL)
    const pool = new Pool({
      connectionString,
      ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
      max: 20,
      idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,
      connectionTimeoutMillis: 15000,
    })
    // Attach error handler to prevent idle connection termination from bubbling as unhandled errors
    pool.on('error', (err) => {
      console.warn('PostgreSQL pool client warning:', err.message)
    })
    globalThis.__PG_POOL__ = pool
  }
  return globalThis.__PG_POOL__
}

'use client'

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react'
import { getAcademicYears } from '@/app/actions/academic-years'
import type { AcademicYear } from '@/lib/types/academic-years'
import { AlertTriangle, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react'

interface AcademicYearContextType {
  systemActiveYear: string
  systemActiveYearName: string
  userViewingYear: string
  setUserViewingYear: (yearId: string) => void
  isViewingArchived: boolean
  academicYears: AcademicYear[]
  resetToActiveYear: () => void
  isLoading: boolean
}

const AcademicYearContext = createContext<AcademicYearContextType>({
  systemActiveYear: '2083',
  systemActiveYearName: '2083 B.S.',
  userViewingYear: '2083',
  setUserViewingYear: () => {},
  isViewingArchived: false,
  academicYears: [],
  resetToActiveYear: () => {},
  isLoading: true,
})

export function AcademicYearProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [academicYears, setAcademicYears] = useState<AcademicYear[]>([])
  const [systemActiveYear, setSystemActiveYear] = useState<string>('2083')
  const [systemActiveYearName, setSystemActiveYearName] = useState<string>('2083 B.S.')
  const [userViewingYear, setUserViewingYearState] = useState<string>('2083')
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true)

  // Load active and configured academic years on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadYears() {
      try {
        const res = await getAcademicYears()
        if (res.success && res.data && res.data.length > 0) {
          setAcademicYears(res.data)
          const current = res.data.find((y) => y.is_current)
          if (current) {
            setSystemActiveYear(current.id)
            setSystemActiveYearName(current.name)
            setUserViewingYearState(current.id)
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load academic cycles in provider:', err)
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false)
      }
    }
    loadYears()
  }, [])

  const setUserViewingYear = useCallback((yearId: string) => {
    setUserViewingYearState(yearId)
  }, [])

  const resetToActiveYear = useCallback(() => {
    setUserViewingYearState(systemActiveYear)
  }, [systemActiveYear])

  const isViewingArchived = useMemo(() => {
    return userViewingYear !== systemActiveYear
  }, [userViewingYear, systemActiveYear])

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      systemActiveYear,
      systemActiveYearName,
      userViewingYear,
      setUserViewingYear,
      isViewingArchived,
      academicYears,
      resetToActiveYear,
      isLoading,
    }),
    [
      systemActiveYear,
      systemActiveYearName,
      userViewingYear,
      setUserViewingYear,
      isViewingArchived,
      academicYears,
      resetToActiveYear,
      isLoading,
    ]
  )

  return (
    <AcademicYearContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </AcademicYearContext.Provider>
  )
}

export function useAcademicYear() {
  return useContext(AcademicYearContext)
}

/**
 * Ambient banner alerting the user when viewing an archived historical year
 */
export function HistoricalArchiveShield() {
  const { isViewingArchived, userViewingYear, academicYears, systemActiveYearName, resetToActiveYear } = useAcademicYear()

  if (!isViewingArchived) return null

  const viewingYearObj = academicYears.find((y) => y.id === userViewingYear)
  const viewingName = viewingYearObj ? viewingYearObj.name : `${userViewingYear} B.S.`

  return (
    <div className="bg-amber-500/10 border-b border-amber-500/20 px-4 py-2 flex items-center justify-between text-amber-400 text-xs font-medium animate-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-150 select-none">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-400" />
        <span>
          Viewing Historical Archive: <strong className="font-bold text-amber-300">{viewingName}</strong> (Historical Read-Only Mode)
        </span>
      </div>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={resetToActiveYear}
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-200 text-[11px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
      >
        <RotateCcw className="h-3 w-3" />
        <span>Switch to Active Cycle ({systemActiveYearName})</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

CODE FILE: D:\Projects\LMR\scratch\audit-database-deep.mjs
=========================================

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function run() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('=== 1. FOREIGN KEYS ACROSS ACADEMIC TABLES ===')
    const fkQuery = `
      SELECT
        tc.table_name, 
        kcu.column_name, 
        ccu.table_name AS foreign_table_name,
        ccu.column_name AS foreign_column_name,
        tc.constraint_name
      FROM information_schema.table_constraints AS tc 
      JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage AS kcu
        ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
        AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
      JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage AS ccu
        ON ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
        AND ccu.table_schema = tc.table_schema
      WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'
        AND tc.table_schema = 'public'
        AND tc.table_name IN (
          'students', 'student_enrollments', 'classes', 'subjects', 'class_subjects',
          'schedules', 'practical_logs', 'log_attendance', 'workstation_seat_plans',
          'session_seat_overrides', 'lab_incidents', 'academic_years', 'workstations'
        )
      ORDER BY tc.table_name, kcu.column_name;
    `
    const fks = await client.query(fkQuery)
    console.log(JSON.stringify(fks.rows, null, 2))

    console.log('=== 2. UNIQUE CONSTRAINTS ===')
    const uqQuery = `
      SELECT
        tc.table_name,
        tc.constraint_name,
        string_agg(kcu.column_name, ', ' ORDER BY kcu.ordinal_position) as columns
      FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
      JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
        ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
        AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
      WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'UNIQUE'
        AND tc.table_schema = 'public'
        AND tc.table_name IN (
          'students', 'student_enrollments', 'classes', 'subjects', 'class_subjects',
          'schedules', 'practical_logs', 'log_attendance', 'workstation_seat_plans',
          'session_seat_overrides'
        )
      GROUP BY tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name
      ORDER BY tc.table_name;
    `
    const uqs = await client.query(uqQuery)
    console.log(JSON.stringify(uqs.rows, null, 2))

    console.log('=== 3. ALL COLUMNS OF ACADEMIC TABLES ===')
    const colsQuery = `
      SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, is_nullable, column_default
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public'
        AND table_name IN (
          'students', 'student_enrollments', 'classes', 'subjects', 'class_subjects',
          'schedules', 'practical_logs', 'log_attendance', 'workstation_seat_plans',
          'session_seat_overrides', 'lab_incidents'
        )
      ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position;
    `
    const cols = await client.query(colsQuery)
    console.log(JSON.stringify(cols.rows, null, 2))

    console.log('=== 4. ROW COUNTS & SAMPLE VALUES ===')
    const tables = [
      'academic_years', 'classes', 'subjects', 'class_subjects',
      'students', 'student_enrollments', 'schedules', 'practical_logs',
      'log_attendance', 'workstation_seat_plans', 'session_seat_overrides', 'lab_incidents'
    ]
    for (const t of tables) {
      const cnt = await client.query(`SELECT count(*) as count FROM public.${t}`)
      console.log(`Table ${t}: ${cnt.rows[0].count} rows`)
    }

  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

run().catch(err => {
  console.error(err)
  process.exit(1)
})

import { getPgPool } from '../lib/db.ts';

const pool = getPgPool();

async function run() {
  const tablesRes = await pool.query(`
    SELECT tablename, rowsecurity 
    FROM pg_tables 
    WHERE schemaname = 'public' 
    ORDER BY tablename ASC;
  `);
  console.log('--- Public Tables and Row Security ---');
  console.table(tablesRes.rows);

  const policiesRes = await pool.query(`
    SELECT tablename, policyname, permissive, roles, cmd
    FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
    ORDER BY tablename, policyname;
  `);
  console.log('--- Total RLS Policies: ' + policiesRes.rows.length + ' ---');
  console.table(policiesRes.rows);

  const missingRLS = tablesRes.rows.filter(t => !t.rowsecurity);
  console.log('--- TABLES WITHOUT RLS ENABLED (' + missingRLS.length + ') ---');
  console.table(missingRLS);

  process.exit(0);
}

run().catch(err => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});

      LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = cs.teacher_id
      LEFT JOIN public.classes c ON c.id = cs.class_id;
    `)
    console.log('CLASS_SUBJECTS:', res.rows)
  } finally {

import pg from 'pg'

import path from 'path'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let rawUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    rawUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

function resolveDatabaseUrl(url) {
  if (!url) return url
  if (url.includes('db.') && url.includes('.supabase.co')) {
    const match = url.match(/postgresql:\/\/([^:]+):(.+)@db\.([a-z0-9]+)\.supabase\.co(?::\d+)?\/(.+)$/)
    if (match) {
      const [, , pass, ref, db] = match
      const decodedPass = decodeURIComponent(pass)
      return `postgresql://postgres.${ref}:${encodeURIComponent(decodedPass)}@aws-0-ap-southeast-1.pooler.supabase.com:5432/${db}`
    }
  }
  return url
}

const connectionString = resolveDatabaseUrl(rawUrl)
const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function inspect() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    const classes = await client.query('SELECT * FROM public.classes;')
    console.log('COUNT in public.classes:', classes.rows.length)
    console.log('ROWS in public.classes:', classes.rows)

    const enrollments = await client.query('SELECT count(*)::int, class_id, academic_year_id FROM public.student_enrollments GROUP BY class_id, academic_year_id;')
    console.log('Enrollments summary:', enrollments.rows)

    const settings = await client.query("SELECT key, value FROM public.institution_settings WHERE key LIKE '%class%';")
    console.log('Class settings in institution_settings:', settings.rows)
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error querying DB:', err)
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

import pg from 'pg'
const { Pool } = pg

const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
})

async function run() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    const colRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_name = 'classes'
      ORDER BY ordinal_position;
    `)
    console.log('COLUMNS IN classes:\n', colRes.rows)

    const fkRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT
        tc.table_name, kcu.column_name,
        ccu.table_name AS foreign_table_name,
        ccu.column_name AS foreign_column_name 
      FROM 
        information_schema.table_constraints AS tc 
        JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage AS kcu
          ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
        JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage AS ccu
          ON ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
      WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY' AND tc.table_name='classes';
    `)
    console.log('FOREIGN KEYS ON classes:\n', fkRes.rows)
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

run().catch(console.error)

CODE FILE: D:\Projects\LMR\scratch\check_db_status.mjs
=========================================

import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';
if (fs.existsSync('.env.local')) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf8');
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const match = line.match(/^\s*([\w_]+)\s*=\s*(.*)?\s*$/);
    if (match && !process.env[match[1]]) {
      process.env[match[1]] = match[2]?.trim().replace(/^['"](.*)['"]$/, '$1');
    }
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false }
});

async function check() {
  try {
    const tables = await pool.query(`
      SELECT tablename, rowsecurity 
      FROM pg_tables 
      WHERE schemaname = 'public' 
      ORDER BY tablename;
    `);
    console.log('TABLES & RLS STATUS:');
    console.table(tables.rows);

    const policies = await pool.query(`
      SELECT tablename, policyname, permissive, roles, cmd, qual, with_check 
      FROM pg_policies 
      WHERE schemaname = 'public' 
      ORDER BY tablename, policyname;
    `);
    console.log('POLICIES:');
    console.table(policies.rows.map(p => ({
      table: p.tablename,
      policy: p.policyname,
      cmd: p.cmd,
      roles: p.roles,
      qual: p.qual ? p.qual.substring(0, 50) : null
    })));

    // Counts
    const checkTables = [
      'practical_logs',
      'lab_incidents',
      'maintenance_plans',
      'maintenance_reminders',
      'maintenance_logs',
      'audit_logs',
      'log_attendance',
      'labs',
      'profiles',
      'institution_settings'
    ];
    const counts = {};
    for (const t of checkTables) {
      try {
        const res = await pool.query(`SELECT count(*) FROM public.${t}`);
        counts[t] = res.rows[0].count;
      } catch (e) {
        counts[t] = 'ERROR: ' + e.message;
      }
    }
    console.log('RECORD COUNTS:', counts);

  } catch(e) {
    console.error('Check failed:', e);
  } finally {
    await pool.end();
  }
}

check();

CODE FILE: D:\Projects\LMR\scratch\clean-db.mjs
=========================================

import pg from 'pg'
import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function clean() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    // Delete any lingering swap test records
    await client.query(`
      DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans 
      WHERE enrollment_id IN (
        SELECT id FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE roll_number >= 100 OR roll_number > 35
      );
    `)
    await client.query(`
      DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments 
      WHERE roll_number >= 100 OR roll_number > 35;
    `)
    await client.query(`
      DELETE FROM public.students 
      WHERE admission_no LIKE 'SWAP-%'
         OR admission_no LIKE 'TEST-P5-%'
         OR admission_no LIKE 'SUCCESS-%'
         OR admission_no LIKE 'FAIL-%'
         OR admission_no LIKE 'IDEM-%';
    `)

    // Delete any lingering test workstations (e.g. PC-99)
    await client.query(`
      DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans 
      WHERE workstation_id IN (
        SELECT id FROM public.workstations WHERE label = 'PC-99'
      );
    `)
    await client.query(`
      DELETE FROM public.session_seat_overrides 
      WHERE workstation_id IN (
        SELECT id FROM public.workstations WHERE label = 'PC-99'
      );
    `)
    await client.query(`
      DELETE FROM public.workstations 
      WHERE label = 'PC-99';
    `)

    const studCount = await client.query(`
      SELECT count(*) FROM public.student_enrollments 
      WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND status = 'active';
    `)
    console.log('12eng active enrollments count:', studCount.rows[0].count)

    const wsCount = await client.query(`
      SELECT count(*) FROM public.workstations WHERE lab_id = 'comp';
    `)
    console.log('comp workstations count:', wsCount.rows[0].count)
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

clean().catch(console.error)

  const classes = await client.query('SELECT id, name FROM public.classes;')
  console.log('Classes:', classes.rows)
  const enrollments = await client.query("SELECT se.id, se.roll_number, s.admission_no, s.full_name FROM public.student_enrollments se JOIN public.students s ON s.id = se.student_id WHERE se.academic_year_id = '2083' AND se.class_id = '12eng' ORDER BY se.roll_number;")

    FROM public.class_subjects cs
    JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id = cs.subject_id
    WHERE cs.academic_year_id = '2083'
    GROUP BY cs.class_id;
  `)
  console.log('Class Subjects by class in 2083:', csByClass.rows)


  // Also check existing workstations and their labs
  const ws = await client.query('SELECT lab_id, count(*) FROM public.workstations GROUP BY lab_id;')

  await pool.end()

import pg from 'pg'
import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'

const envContent = fs.readFileSync(path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local'), 'utf8')
let dbUrl = ''
for (const line of envContent.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
  }
}
const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function run() {
  const tables = ['students', 'student_enrollments', 'academic_years', 'classes']
  for (const t of tables) {
    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable, column_default
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = $1
      ORDER BY ordinal_position;
    `, [t])
    console.log('=== TABLE:', t, '===')
    console.table(res.rows)
  }

  const cRes = await pool.query(`
    SELECT conrelid::regclass AS table_name, conname, contype, pg_get_constraintdef(oid) as def
    FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid IN ('public.students'::regclass, 'public.student_enrollments'::regclass);
  `)
  console.log('=== CONSTRAINTS ===')
  console.table(cRes.rows)

  // Also check existing student counts and enrollments
  const stCount = await pool.query('SELECT count(*) FROM public.students;')
  const enCount = await pool.query('SELECT count(*) FROM public.student_enrollments;')
  const years = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM public.academic_years;')
  const classes = await pool.query('SELECT * FROM public.classes ORDER BY id;')

  console.log('=== COUNTS & SEEDED DATA ===')
  console.log('Students count:', stCount.rows[0].count)
  console.log('Enrollments count:', enCount.rows[0].count)
  console.log('Academic Years:', years.rows)
  console.log('Classes:', classes.rows.map(c => `${c.id} (${c.name})`))

  await pool.end()
}

run().catch(console.error)

CODE FILE: D:\Projects\LMR\scratch\migrate_classes_streams.mjs
=========================================

import pg from 'pg'
const { Pool } = pg

const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
})

async function run() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN')

    console.log('1. Populating public.streams reference table...')
    await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.streams (id, name, code) VALUES
        ('Computer Engineering', 'Computer Engineering', 'ENG'),
        ('Management', 'Management', 'MGT'),
        ('General Science', 'General Science', 'SCI'),
        ('Basic Science & Computing', 'Basic Science & Computing', 'BSC'),
        ('tech', 'Computer Engineering', 'TECH'),
        ('science', 'General Science', 'SCIN'),
        ('school', 'General School', 'SCH')
      ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, code = EXCLUDED.code;
    `)

    console.log('2. Normalizing public.classes records...')
    // For classes that have null stream_id, populate stream_id from section if section has stream description
    await client.query(`
      UPDATE public.classes
      SET stream_id = 'Computer Engineering', section = 'Eng'
      WHERE id = '12eng';
    `)

    await client.query(`
      UPDATE public.classes
      SET stream_id = 'Management', section = 'Mgt'
      WHERE id = '12mgt';
    `)

    await client.query(`
      UPDATE public.classes
      SET stream_id = 'Computer Engineering', section = 'Eng'
      WHERE id = '11eng';
    `)

    await client.query(`
      UPDATE public.classes
      SET stream_id = 'Management', section = 'Mgt'
      WHERE id = '11mgt';
    `)

    await client.query(`
      UPDATE public.classes
      SET stream_id = 'Computer Engineering', section = 'Eng'
      WHERE id = '10eng';
    `)

import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'
import pg from 'pg'
import crypto from 'crypto'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
    const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
    const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
    const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    if (!process.env[key]) process.env[key] = val
  }
}
function resolveDatabaseUrl(rawUrl) {
  if (!rawUrl) return rawUrl
  const match = rawUrl.match(/postgresql:\/\/([^:]+):(.+)@db\.([a-z0-9]+)\.supabase\.co(?::\d+)?\/(.+)$/)
  if (match) {
    const [, , pass, ref, db] = match
    return 'postgresql://postgres.' + ref + ':' + encodeURIComponent(decodeURIComponent(pass)) + '@aws-0-ap-southeast-1.pooler.supabase.com:5432/' + db
  }
  return rawUrl
}
const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: resolveDatabaseUrl(process.env.DATABASE_URL), ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

try {
  // 1. Get Class 10 unenrolled students sorted by admission_no
  const studentsRes = await pool.query(`
    SELECT s.id, s.admission_no, s.full_name
    FROM public.students s
    LEFT JOIN public.student_enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id AND e.class_id = '10eng'
    WHERE e.id IS NULL AND s.admission_no LIKE 'ADM-2083-01%'
    ORDER BY s.admission_no ASC
  `)
  console.log(`Found ${studentsRes.rows.length} Class 10 students to enroll.`)

  // 2. Get workstations for comp lab sorted by label numerically
  const wsRes = await pool.query(`
    SELECT id, label 
    FROM public.workstations 
    WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND is_active = true
  `)
  const sortedStations = wsRes.rows.sort((a, b) =>
    a.label.localeCompare(b.label, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' })
  )
  console.log(`Found ${sortedStations.length} workstations in comp lab.`)

  // 3. Begin transaction
  await pool.query('BEGIN')

  for (let i = 0; i < studentsRes.rows.length; i++) {
    const student = studentsRes.rows[i]
    const rollNumber = i + 1
    const enrollmentId = crypto.randomUUID()

    // Insert student_enrollment
    await pool.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (id, academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, section, status, created_at, updated_at)
      VALUES ($1, '2083', '10eng', $2, $3, 'A', 'active', NOW(), NOW())
    `, [enrollmentId, student.id, rollNumber])

    // Assign to workstation if available
    if (i < sortedStations.length) {
      const station = sortedStations[i]
      const planId = crypto.randomUUID()
      await pool.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (id, lab_id, academic_year_id, class_id, workstation_id, enrollment_id, created_at, updated_at)
        VALUES ($1, 'comp', '2083', '10eng', $2, $3, NOW(), NOW())
      `, [planId, station.id, enrollmentId])

      if (i < 5 || i === studentsRes.rows.length - 1) {
        console.log(`Enrolled & Seated: Roll ${rollNumber} (${student.full_name}) -> ${station.label}`)
      }
    }
  }

  await pool.query('COMMIT')
  console.log('Successfully enrolled Class 10 students and created baseline seat plan!')
} catch (err) {
  await pool.query('ROLLBACK')
  console.error('Error seeding Class 10:', err)
} finally {
  await pool.end()
}

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function run() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('ðŸš€ Applying Phase 4.5 Stage 1 DDL Migration...')
    const sqlPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'scripts/migration-phase4-5-stage1-add-columns.sql')
    const sql = fs.readFileSync(sqlPath, 'utf8')

    await client.query(sql)
    console.log('âœ… Stage 1 DDL executed successfully!')

    // Verification of added columns and constraints
    console.log('ðŸ” Verifying schema changes...')
    const cols = await client.query(`
      SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, is_nullable
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public'
        AND (
          (table_name = 'class_subjects' AND column_name = 'academic_year_id') OR
          (table_name = 'schedules' AND column_name = 'class_subject_id') OR
          (table_name = 'practical_logs' AND column_name = 'class_subject_id') OR
          (table_name = 'log_attendance' AND column_name = 'enrollment_id') OR
          (table_name = 'lab_incidents' AND column_name IN ('class_id', 'subject_id', 'subject_teacher_id'))
        )
      ORDER BY table_name, column_name;
    `)
    console.log('Verified Columns:', JSON.stringify(cols.rows, null, 2))

    const constraints = await client.query(`
      SELECT tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name, tc.constraint_type
      FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
      WHERE tc.table_schema = 'public'
        AND tc.constraint_name IN (
          'uq_class_subject_teaching_assignment',
          'uq_student_enrollments_id_student',
          'fk_log_attendance_enrollment_student',
          'fk_practical_logs_schedule'
        )
      ORDER BY tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name;
    `)
    console.log('Verified Constraints:', JSON.stringify(constraints.rows, null, 2))

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('âŒ Stage 1 Migration Failed:', err)
    process.exit(1)
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

run()

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')

  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')

  }

if (!dbUrl) {
  console.error('âŒ DATABASE_URL not found in .env.local')
  process.exit(1)
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function runStage2Migration() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('ðŸ›¡ï¸ STEP 10 PRE-FLIGHT: Checking Stop-Gates before Stage 2 enforcement...')

    // 1. Check Step 06 Gates
    const gateRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT 
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.schedules WHERE class_subject_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_schedules,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.practical_logs WHERE class_subject_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_logs,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.class_subjects WHERE academic_year_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_assignments,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.log_attendance WHERE enrollment_id IS NULL OR student_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_attendance;
    `)
    const gate = gateRes.rows[0]
    console.log(`Gate metrics:
  - unlinked_schedules: ${gate.unlinked_schedules}
  - unlinked_logs: ${gate.unlinked_logs}
  - unlinked_assignments: ${gate.unlinked_assignments}
  - unlinked_attendance: ${gate.unlinked_attendance}`)

    if (
      parseInt(gate.unlinked_schedules, 10) > 0 ||
      parseInt(gate.unlinked_logs, 10) > 0 ||
      parseInt(gate.unlinked_assignments, 10) > 0 ||
      parseInt(gate.unlinked_attendance, 10) > 0
    ) {
      console.error('âŒ STOP-GATE TRIGGERED: Unlinked rows detected. Aborting Stage 2 migration.')
      process.exit(1)
    }

    console.log('âœ… ALL PRE-FLIGHT STOP-GATES PASSED. Applying Stage 2 DDL Migration...')

    const sqlPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'scripts/migration-phase4-5-stage2-enforce-integrity.sql')
    const sql = fs.readFileSync(sqlPath, 'utf8')

    await client.query(sql)

    console.log('âœ… STAGE 2 DDL APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!')

    // Verify NOT NULL status
    const verifyRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT 
        table_name, column_name, is_nullable
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public'
        AND (
          (table_name = 'class_subjects' AND column_name = 'academic_year_id') OR
          (table_name = 'schedules' AND column_name = 'class_subject_id') OR
          (table_name = 'practical_logs' AND column_name = 'class_subject_id') OR
          (table_name = 'log_attendance' AND column_name IN ('enrollment_id', 'student_id'))
        )
      ORDER BY table_name, column_name;
    `)

    console.log('ðŸ“‹ Verified column nullability status:')
    for (const r of verifyRes.rows) {
      console.log(`  - ${r.table_name}.${r.column_name}: is_nullable = ${r.is_nullable}`)
      if (r.is_nullable !== 'NO') {
        throw new Error(`Column ${r.table_name}.${r.column_name} is still nullable!`)
      }
    }

    console.log('ðŸŽ‰ ALL NOT NULL INVARIANTS CONFIRMED!')
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('âŒ Stage 2 migration failed:', err)
    process.exit(1)
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

CODE FILE: D:\Projects\LMR\scripts\audit-attendance-classification.mjs

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function runAudit() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('ðŸ” STEP 09: Running Attendance Classification Audit...')

    const query = `
      SELECT 
        la.id,
        la.log_id,
        la.student_id,
        la.roll_number,
        la.enrollment_id,
        pl.date AS session_date,
        pl.batch_group,
        pl.class_subject_id
      FROM public.log_attendance la
      LEFT JOIN public.practical_logs pl ON pl.id = la.log_id;
    `
    const res = await client.query(query)
    const rows = res.rows

    console.log(`ðŸ“Š Found ${rows.length} rows in public.log_attendance.`)

    const activeEnrollmentsRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT se.id as enrollment_id, se.student_id, se.academic_year_id, se.class_id, se.roll_number
      FROM public.student_enrollments se
      WHERE se.status = 'active';
    `)
    const enrollments = activeEnrollmentsRes.rows

    const classified = {
      valid: [],
      recoverable: [],
      legacySynthetic: [],
      orphaned: [],
    }

    for (const row of rows) {
      if (row.enrollment_id && row.student_id) {
        // Check if student_id matches enrollment
        const match = enrollments.find(e => e.enrollment_id === row.enrollment_id && e.student_id === row.student_id)
        if (match) {
          classified.valid.push(row)
        } else {
          classified.orphaned.push({ ...row, reason: 'enrollment_id and student_id mismatch' })
        }
      } else if (!row.log_id) {
        classified.orphaned.push({ ...row, reason: 'missing log_id' })
      } else if (row.roll_number) {
        // Try to match active enrollment
        // If row has student_id or roll_number matching practical_logs cohort
        const matches = enrollments.filter(e => e.roll_number === row.roll_number)
        if (matches.length === 1) {
          classified.recoverable.push({ ...row, matchedEnrollment: matches[0] })
        } else if (matches.length === 0 && !row.student_id) {
          classified.legacySynthetic.push(row)
        } else {
          classified.orphaned.push({ ...row, reason: `ambiguous roll_number match count: ${matches.length}` })
        }
      } else {
        classified.legacySynthetic.push(row)
      }
    }

    const report = {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      totalRows: rows.length,
      counts: {
        valid: classified.valid.length,
        recoverable: classified.recoverable.length,
        legacySynthetic: classified.legacySynthetic.length,
        orphaned: classified.orphaned.length,
      },
      details: classified,
    }

    const outPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'scratch/attendance-classification-report.json')
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPath), { recursive: true })
    fs.writeFileSync(outPath, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2))
    console.log(`ðŸ“ Classification report saved to ${outPath}`)
    console.log(`Results summary: Valid: ${report.counts.valid}, Recoverable: ${report.counts.recoverable}, Legacy-Synthetic: ${report.counts.legacySynthetic}, Orphaned: ${report.counts.orphaned}`)

    return report
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

runAudit().catch(err => {
  console.error('Audit failed:', err)
  process.exit(1)
})

CODE FILE: D:\Projects\LMR\scripts\audit_db.mjs
=========================================

import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';

let dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
if (!dbUrl) {
  try {
    const env = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf8');
    for (const line of env.split('\n')) {
      const [k, ...v] = line.split('=');
      if (k && k.trim() === 'DATABASE_URL') dbUrl = v.join('=').trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
    }
  } catch {}
}

const client = new pg.Client({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function run() {
  await client.connect();

  const tables = await client.query("SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name");

  const profiles = await client.query("SELECT id, full_name, email, role, department, permissions FROM profiles ORDER BY full_name");

  const labs = await client.query("SELECT id, name, type, capacity, is_active FROM labs ORDER BY id");

  const schedules = await client.query("SELECT id, lab_id, teacher_id, subject_name, batch_name, slot_id, day_key, start_time, end_time, status, metadata FROM schedules ORDER BY lab_id, day_key, slot_id");

  const schedulesByTeacher = await client.query(`
    SELECT s.teacher_id, p.full_name, p.role, count(*) as session_count,
           array_agg(DISTINCT s.subject_name) as subjects,
           array_agg(DISTINCT s.batch_name) as batches,
           array_agg(DISTINCT s.lab_id) as labs
    FROM schedules s
    LEFT JOIN profiles p ON s.teacher_id = p.id
    GROUP BY s.teacher_id, p.full_name, p.role
  `);

  const practicalLogs = await client.query("SELECT id, lab_id, teacher_id, date, period_label, subject_name, batch_group, practical_title, total_students, present_students, absent_students, topic_learned, status FROM practical_logs ORDER BY date DESC");

  const incidents = await client.query("SELECT id, lab_id, subject_name, subject_teacher_name, batch_name, title, status, severity, reported_by, reported_by_id, resolved_by_id FROM lab_incidents");

  const dump = {
    tables: tables.rows.map(r => r.table_name),
    profiles: profiles.rows,
    labs: labs.rows,
    schedulesCount: schedules.rows.length,
    teacherAssignments: schedulesByTeacher.rows,
    sampleSchedules: schedules.rows.slice(0, 15),
    practicalLogs: practicalLogs.rows,
    incidents: incidents.rows,
  };

  fs.writeFileSync('scratch_db_dump.json', JSON.stringify(dump, null, 2));
  console.log('Successfully wrote scratch_db_dump.json');

  await client.end();
}

run().catch(console.error);
