// Load environment variables for database connection
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const k = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const v = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')

    }
  }
}

  await t.test('7. promoteCohortAction: Promotes cohort successfully and updates status without constraint violations', async () => {
    const { promoteCohortAction } = await import('../app/actions/academic-years.ts')
    const { getPgPool } = await import('../lib/db.ts')
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const client = await pool.connect()

    const testStudentId1 = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
    const testStudentId2 = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'
    const testStudentId3 = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'

    try {
      // Setup test students
      for (const sid of [testStudentId1, testStudentId2, testStudentId3]) {
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active)
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, true)
          ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name;
        `, [sid, `ADM-${sid}`, `Student ${sid}`])
      }

      // Cleanup any leftover enrollments
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id IN ($1, $2, $3) OR (academic_year_id IN ('2083', '2084') AND class_id IN ('7b', '8a'));`, [testStudentId1, testStudentId2, testStudentId3])

      // Seed 2083 enrollments in 7b
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, section, status)
        VALUES 
          ('2083', '7b', $1, 1, 'A', 'active'),
          ('2083', '7b', $2, 2, 'A', 'active'),
          ('2083', '7b', $3, 3, 'A', 'active');
      `, [testStudentId1, testStudentId2, testStudentId3])

      // Execute promotion:
      // student 1: promote to 8a in 2084
      // student 2: repeat in 7b in 2084
      // student 3: archive / left school
      const promoRes = await promoteCohortAction({
        fromClassId: '7b',
        toClassId: '8a',
        fromAcademicYearId: '2083',
        toAcademicYearId: '2084',
        exceptions: [
          { studentId: testStudentId2, action: 'repeat' },
          { studentId: testStudentId3, action: 'archive' },
        ],
        internalBypassScopeCheck: true,
      })

      assert.equal(promoRes.success, true, `Cohort promotion should succeed: ${promoRes.error}`)

      // Verify student 1: prior enrollment is archived, new enrollment is active in 8a
      const s1Old = await client.query(`SELECT status FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND student_id = $1;`, [testStudentId1])
      assert.equal(s1Old.rows[0]?.status, 'archived', 'Promoted student prior enrollment should be archived')

      const s1New = await client.query(`SELECT status, class_id FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2084' AND student_id = $1;`, [testStudentId1])
      assert.equal(s1New.rows[0]?.status, 'active', 'Promoted student new enrollment should be active')
      assert.equal(s1New.rows[0]?.class_id, '8a', 'Promoted student new class should be 8a')

      // Verify student 2: prior enrollment is archived, new enrollment is active in 7b
      const s2Old = await client.query(`SELECT status FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND student_id = $1;`, [testStudentId2])
      assert.equal(s2Old.rows[0]?.status, 'archived', 'Repeating student prior enrollment should be archived')

      const s2New = await client.query(`SELECT status, class_id FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2084' AND student_id = $1;`, [testStudentId2])
      assert.equal(s2New.rows[0]?.status, 'active', 'Repeating student new enrollment should be active')
      assert.equal(s2New.rows[0]?.class_id, '7b', 'Repeating student should remain in 7b')

      // Verify student 3: marked transferred, no 2084 enrollment
      const s3Old = await client.query(`SELECT status FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND student_id = $1;`, [testStudentId3])
      assert.equal(s3Old.rows[0]?.status, 'transferred', 'Archived student prior enrollment should be transferred')

      const s3New = await client.query(`SELECT * FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2084' AND student_id = $1;`, [testStudentId3])
      assert.equal(s3New.rows.length, 0, 'Archived student should have no new enrollment')

    } finally {
      // Clean up test data
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id IN ($1, $2, $3) OR (academic_year_id IN ('2083', '2084') AND class_id IN ('7b', '8a'));`, [testStudentId1, testStudentId2, testStudentId3])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2, $3);`, [testStudentId1, testStudentId2, testStudentId3])
      client.release()
    }
  })

  await t.test('8. updateAcademicYearAction: Safely updates display label and dates without altering ID or hampering linked records', async () => {
    const { updateAcademicYearAction } = await import('../app/actions/academic-years.ts')
    const { getPgPool } = await import('../lib/db.ts')
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const client = await pool.connect()

    try {
      // 1. Fetch current 2083 name & dates
      const origRes = await client.query(`SELECT id, name, start_date, end_date FROM public.academic_years WHERE id = '2083';`)
      assert.equal(origRes.rows.length, 1, '2083 exists in database')
      const orig = origRes.rows[0]

      // Count existing linked practical logs & enrollments before edit
      const logsBefore = await client.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.practical_logs WHERE academic_year_id = '2083';`)
      const enrollBefore = await client.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083';`)

      // 2. Perform safe update

        id: '2083',

        start_date: '2083-01-01',
        end_date: '2083-12-30',
        internalBypassScopeCheck: true,
      })

      assert.equal(updateRes.success, true, 'updateAcademicYearAction should succeed')
      assert.equal(updateRes.data?.id, '2083', 'Primary key ID remains 2083')
      assert.equal(updateRes.data?.name, '2083/84 B.S. (Amended)', 'Display label updated')

      // Verify linked practical logs & enrollments are completely intact (0 data hampered)
      const logsAfter = await client.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.practical_logs WHERE academic_year_id = '2083';`)
      const enrollAfter = await client.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083';`)
      assert.equal(logsAfter.rows[0].count, logsBefore.rows[0].count, 'Practical log count untouched')
      assert.equal(enrollAfter.rows[0].count, enrollBefore.rows[0].count, 'Student enrollment count untouched')

      // 3. Restore original name
      await client.query(`UPDATE public.academic_years SET name = $1, start_date = $2, end_date = $3 WHERE id = '2083';`, [
        orig.name,
        orig.start_date,
        orig.end_date,
      ])
    } finally {
      client.release()
    }
  })

import { describe, it } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

// Load .env.local into process.env before any DB clients load
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[key]) {
        process.env[key] = val
      }
    }
  }
}

// Now dynamically import terminal action functions with populated environment
const {
  verifyTerminalAccess,
  submitStudentIssueReport,
  getLiveAssistanceRequests,
  acknowledgeAssistanceRequest,
} = await import('../app/actions/terminal.ts')

const { TERMINAL_QUICK_ISSUES } = await import('../lib/types/terminal.ts')

describe('Phase 1: Zero-Login Student Terminal Self-Reporting & Live Help Beacon', () => {
  const dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL

  it('Schema Integrity: public.workstations has lan_ip and pairing_token columns', async () => {
    if (!dbUrl) return
    const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT column_name, data_type 
      FROM information_schema.columns 
      WHERE table_name = 'workstations' AND column_name IN ('lan_ip', 'pairing_token');
    `)
    await pool.end()

    const cols = res.rows.map((r) => r.column_name)
    assert.ok(cols.includes('lan_ip'), 'workstations must have lan_ip')
    assert.ok(cols.includes('pairing_token'), 'workstations must have pairing_token')
  })

  it('Schema Integrity: public.workstation_issues supports student self-reporting (nullable reported_by_id, source, student fields)', async () => {
    if (!dbUrl) return
    const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT column_name, is_nullable 
      FROM information_schema.columns 
      WHERE table_name = 'workstation_issues' AND column_name IN ('reported_by_id', 'source', 'student_name', 'student_roll');
    `)
    await pool.end()

    const colMap = Object.fromEntries(res.rows.map((r) => [r.column_name, r.is_nullable]))
    assert.equal(colMap.reported_by_id, 'YES', 'reported_by_id must be nullable for student reports')
    assert.ok('source' in colMap, 'workstation_issues must have source column')
    assert.ok('student_name' in colMap, 'workstation_issues must have student_name column')
    assert.ok('student_roll' in colMap, 'workstation_issues must have student_roll column')
  })

  it('Domain Models: TERMINAL_QUICK_ISSUES contains standard 6 alive-only issue chips', () => {
    assert.equal(TERMINAL_QUICK_ISSUES.length, 6)
    const ids = TERMINAL_QUICK_ISSUES.map((c) => c.id)
    assert.ok(ids.includes('peripherals'))
    assert.ok(ids.includes('no_internet'))
    assert.ok(ids.includes('missing_software'))
    assert.ok(ids.includes('app_freeze'))
    assert.ok(ids.includes('audio_issue'))
    assert.ok(ids.includes('other'))
  })

  it('Server Action Pure RPC Exports: app/actions/terminal.ts only exports async functions (Rule #13)', () => {
    const filePath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'app/actions/terminal.ts')
    const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8')

    // Find all export statements
    const exportMatches = content.match(/export\s+(?:async\s+function|const|let|var|function|type|interface)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/g) || []
    for (const exp of exportMatches) {
      assert.ok(
        exp.startsWith('export async function'),
        `Forbidden non-async export found in 'use server' file: "${exp}". Adhere to Rule #13.`
      )
    }
  })

  it('Anti-Spoofing Engine: verifyTerminalAccess validates workstation and blocks mismatched pairing tokens', async () => {
    if (!dbUrl) return

    // 1. Unknown workstation should be rejected
    const unknownRes = await verifyTerminalAccess('NON_EXISTENT_STATION_9999')
    assert.equal(unknownRes.allowed, false)

    // 2. Query a seeded workstation from DB
    const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
    const wsRes = await pool.query(`SELECT id, label, pairing_token FROM public.workstations WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1`)
    if (wsRes.rows.length === 0) {
      await pool.end()
      return
    }

    const testWs = wsRes.rows[0]

    // Set a known pairing token on test workstation
    await pool.query(`UPDATE public.workstations SET pairing_token = 'TEST-SECRET-123' WHERE id = $1`, [testWs.id])

    // Case A: Matching token should be allowed
    const validRes = await verifyTerminalAccess(testWs.label, 'TEST-SECRET-123')
    assert.equal(validRes.allowed, true)
    assert.equal(validRes.tokenMatched, true)

    // Case B: Mismatched token should be blocked by anti-spoofing lock
    const spoofedRes = await verifyTerminalAccess(testWs.label, 'WRONG-SPOOFED-TOKEN')
    assert.equal(spoofedRes.allowed, false)
    assert.ok(spoofedRes.reason?.includes('Anti-Spoofing Lock'))

    // Cleanup token
    await pool.query(`UPDATE public.workstations SET pairing_token = $1 WHERE id = $2`, [testWs.pairing_token, testWs.id])
    await pool.end()
  })

  it('Student Reporting & Cockpit Beacon: submitStudentIssueReport inserts student report and beacon alerts', async () => {
    if (!dbUrl) return

    const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
    const wsRes = await pool.query(`SELECT id, label, lab_id, pairing_token FROM public.workstations WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1`)
    if (wsRes.rows.length === 0) {
      await pool.end()
      return
    }

    const testWs = wsRes.rows[0]
    const labId = testWs.lab_id || 'comp'

    // Submit report as student
    const submitRes = await submitStudentIssueReport({
      stationCode: testWs.label,
      issueTag: 'missing_software',
      title: 'VS Code Missing Python Extension',
      description: 'Cannot run practical script in laboratory session',
      studentName: 'Test Student',
      studentRoll: '99',
      pairingToken: testWs.pairing_token || undefined,
    })

    assert.equal(submitRes.success, true, `Report submission failed: ${submitRes.error}`)
    assert.ok(submitRes.issueId, 'Must return issueId')

    // Verify it appears in live assistance requests
    const beaconRes = await getLiveAssistanceRequests(labId)
    assert.equal(beaconRes.success, true)
    const matchingReq = beaconRes.requests.find((r) => r.id === submitRes.issueId)
    assert.ok(matchingReq, 'Student report must appear in Live Assistance Requests queue')
    assert.equal(matchingReq.studentName, 'Test Student')
    assert.equal(matchingReq.studentRoll, '99')

    // Acknowledge the request
    const ackRes = await acknowledgeAssistanceRequest(submitRes.issueId)
    assert.equal(ackRes.success, true)

    // Clean up test issue from database

import { describe, it, before, after } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

import { generateBlankRosterTemplate } from '../lib/roster-ingestion/template.ts'
import { parseRosterFile } from '../lib/roster-ingestion/parser.ts'
import { validateParsedRoster, formatAutoAdmissionNo } from '../lib/roster-ingestion/validator.ts'
import { resolveUserScope } from '../lib/context/user-scope.ts'

function loadDbUrl() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath)) return null
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
      return line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
    }
  }
  return null
}

const dbUrl = loadDbUrl()

async function buildDbValidationContext(client, academicYearId, classId) {
  const classRes = await client.query(`SELECT id, name FROM public.classes WHERE id = $1;`, [classId])
  const yearRes = await client.query(`SELECT id, name FROM public.academic_years WHERE id = $1;`, [academicYearId])

  const studRes = await client.query(`SELECT id, full_name, admission_no, registration_no FROM public.students WHERE is_active = true;`)
  const existingStudentsByAdmissionNo = new Map()
  const existingStudentsByRegistrationNo = new Map()
  const allActiveStudents = []
  for (const s of studRes.rows) {
    allActiveStudents.push({ id: s.id, full_name: s.full_name, admission_no: s.admission_no })
    if (s.admission_no) existingStudentsByAdmissionNo.set(s.admission_no.toLowerCase().trim(), s)
    if (s.registration_no) existingStudentsByRegistrationNo.set(s.registration_no.toLowerCase().trim(), s)
  }

  const enrollRes = await client.query(`
    SELECT se.id, se.student_id, se.roll_number, s.full_name
    FROM public.student_enrollments se
    JOIN public.students s ON s.id = se.student_id
    WHERE se.academic_year_id = $1 AND se.class_id = $2 AND se.status = 'active';
  `, [academicYearId, classId])
  const existingEnrollmentsByStudentId = new Map()
  const existingEnrollmentsByRoll = new Map()
  for (const e of enrollRes.rows) {
    existingEnrollmentsByStudentId.set(e.student_id, { id: e.id, roll_number: e.roll_number })
    existingEnrollmentsByRoll.set(e.roll_number, { id: e.id, student_id: e.student_id, full_name: e.full_name })
  }

  return {
    targetAcademicYearId: academicYearId,
    targetAcademicYearName: yearRes.rows[0]?.name || academicYearId,
    targetClassId: classId,
    targetClassName: classRes.rows[0]?.name || classId,
    existingStudentsByAdmissionNo,
    existingStudentsByRegistrationNo,
    allActiveStudents,
    existingEnrollmentsByStudentId,
    existingEnrollmentsByRoll,
  }
}

function buildMockValidationContext(academicYearId = '2083', classId = '12eng') {
  return {
    targetAcademicYearId: academicYearId,
    targetAcademicYearName: '2083-2084 BS',
    targetClassId: classId,
    targetClassName: 'Class 12 Science (Eng)',
    existingStudentsByAdmissionNo: new Map(),
    existingStudentsByRegistrationNo: new Map(),
    allActiveStudents: [],
    existingEnrollmentsByStudentId: new Map(),
    existingEnrollmentsByRoll: new Map(),
  }
}

        SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
          '2083',
          '12eng',

        ) as result;
      `, [JSON.stringify(payload)])

      const result = res.rows[0].result
      assert.equal(result.processed_rows, 2)
      assert.equal(result.students_created, 2)
      assert.equal(result.enrollments_created, 2)

      // Cleanup
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments
        WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND roll_number IN (145, 146);
      `)
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.students WHERE admission_no LIKE $1;
      `, [`${runTag}%`])
    })
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // 5. RE-IMPORT IDEMPOTENCY & ROLL MISMATCH CONFLICT DETECTION
  // =========================================================================
  describe('5. Idempotent Re-import & Roll Discrepancy Protection', () => {
    it('re-importing the identical roster retains existing records without duplicates', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      const runTag = `IDEM-${Date.now()}`
      const payload = [
        { roll_number: 151, full_name: 'Idempotent Student 1', admission_no: `${runTag}-1`, registration_no: null },
        { roll_number: 152, full_name: 'Idempotent Student 2', admission_no: `${runTag}-2`, registration_no: null },
      ]

      // First Import
      const firstRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
          '2083',
          '12eng',
          $1::jsonb
        ) as result;
      `, [JSON.stringify(payload)])
      assert.equal(firstRes.rows[0].result.students_created, 2)
      assert.equal(firstRes.rows[0].result.enrollments_created, 2)

      // Second Import: EXACT SAME ROSTER

          '2083',
          '12eng',

      `, [JSON.stringify(payload)])

      assert.equal(r2.students_created, 0, 'No duplicate students created')
      assert.equal(r2.enrollments_created, 0, 'No duplicate enrollments created')
      assert.equal(r2.enrollments_retained, 2, 'Both enrollments retained idempotently')

      // Roll Shift Resolution: Same student (identified by admission_no) updates roll from 151 to 153 cleanly
      const rollShiftRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
          '2083',
          '12eng',
          $1::jsonb,
          'sync'
        ) as result;
      `, [JSON.stringify([

      ])])
      const rShift = rollShiftRes.rows[0].result
      assert.equal(rShift.enrollments_updated, 1, 'Roll shifted cleanly from 151 to 153 without error')

      // Cleanup
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments
        WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND roll_number IN (151, 152, 153);
      `)
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE admission_no LIKE $1;`, [`${runTag}%`])
    })
  })

    it('transfers student to a new cohort while preserving previous enrollment as transferred', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      try {

        // Update previous enrollment to 'transferred'
        await client.query(`
          UPDATE public.student_enrollments
          SET status = 'transferred'
          WHERE id = $1;

        // Insert new active enrollment in 12eng
        const newEnrollRes = await client.query(`

          VALUES ($1, '2083', '12eng', 160, 'active')
          RETURNING id;
        `, [studentId])
        const newEnrollId = newEnrollRes.rows[0].id

        // Verify history
        const enrollments = await client.query(`
          SELECT id, class_id, status FROM public.student_enrollments
          WHERE student_id = $1
          ORDER BY created_at ASC;
        `, [studentId])

        assert.equal(enrollments.rows.length, 2, 'Must have exactly 2 enrollment records')
        assert.equal(enrollments.rows[0].class_id, '11eng')
        assert.equal(enrollments.rows[0].status, 'transferred')
        assert.equal(enrollments.rows[1].class_id, '12eng')
        assert.equal(enrollments.rows[1].status, 'active')
      } finally {
        await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id = $1;`, [studentId])
        await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [studentId])
      }
    })
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // 7. TEACHER AUTHORIZATION & SESSION-SCOPED READ-ONLY VISIBILITY
  // =========================================================================
  describe('7. Teacher Authorization & Roster Security Boundaries', () => {
    it('restricts teacher role to session-only read access and prevents roster administrative operations', () => {
      const teacherProfile = {
        id: '4911cee7-dae4-48a2-90de-9b039712de35',
        email: 'a.karki@rrl.edu.np',
        full_name: 'Er. Anish Karki',
        role: 'teacher',
        approval_status: 'approved',
        is_active: true,
        permissions: {},
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }

      const scope = resolveUserScope(teacherProfile)
      assert.equal(scope.isPrivileged, false, 'Teacher must not be privileged')
      assert.equal(scope.isTeacher, true)
    })
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // 8. DECOUPLED CAPACITY & VISUAL SEAT PLANNER INTEGRATION
  // =========================================================================
  describe('8. Decoupled Capacity (35 Students vs 34 Workstations)', () => {
    it('handles cohort where student count exceeds workstation count, staging excess in unassigned tray', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      // In computer lab 'comp', there are 34 workstations (PC-01 to PC-34)
      const wsCountRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM public.workstations WHERE lab_id = 'comp';
      `)
      const wsCount = parseInt(wsCountRes.rows[0].cnt, 10)
      assert.equal(wsCount, 34, 'Computer lab must have exactly 34 workstations')

      // Query active enrollments for 12eng in 2083
      const enrollRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM public.student_enrollments
        WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND status = 'active';
      `)
      const enrollCount = parseInt(enrollRes.rows[0].cnt, 10)
      assert.ok(enrollCount >= 34, 'Cohort has 34+ active students')

      // Verify that unassigned students are properly handled without crash
      const seatPlansRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
        WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng';
      `)
      const assignedCount = parseInt(seatPlansRes.rows[0].cnt, 10)
      assert.ok(assignedCount <= wsCount, 'Assigned seats cannot exceed physical workstation count')

import { describe, it, before, after } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

import {
  validateParsedRoster,
  formatAutoAdmissionNo,
  isExactNormalizedNameMatch,
} from '../lib/roster-ingestion/validator.ts'

function loadDbUrl() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath)) return null
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
      return line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
    }
  }
  return null
}

const dbUrl = loadDbUrl()

describe('Phase 6: Unified Roster Ingestion & Cohort Lifecycle Suite', () => {

  // =========================================================================
  // 2. ATOMIC CLEAN SLATE OBLITERATION & ZERO-HISTORY SAFETY GUARD
  // =========================================================================
  describe('2. PostgreSQL RPC Clean Slate & Active History Protection', () => {
    it('Safety Guard: Rejects Clean Slate replacement when cohort has active practical attendance history', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      // In 2083, Class 12eng has practical attendance logs
      let rejected = false
      let errorMessage = ''
      try {
        await client.query(`
          SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
            '2083',
            '12eng',
            $1::jsonb,
            'clean_slate'
          );
        `, [JSON.stringify([
          { roll_number: 1, full_name: 'Replacement Student 1', admission_no: null, registration_no: null },
        ])])
      } catch (err) {
        rejected = true
        errorMessage = err.message
      }

      assert.ok(rejected, 'Clean slate wipe must be strictly rejected when practical attendance history exists')
      assert.ok(
        errorMessage.includes('CANNOT_WIPE_ACTIVE_HISTORY'),
        `Error must identify CANNOT_WIPE_ACTIVE_HISTORY. Received: ${errorMessage}`
      )
    })

    it('Clean Slate Execution: Atomically obliterates zero-history dummy cohort and installs fresh roster', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      const testYear = '2083'
      const testClass = '11mgt'
      const tag = `CS-TEST-${Date.now()}`

      // Pre-cleanup in case a previous run terminated prematurely
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans 
        WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2;
      `, [testYear, testClass])
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments 
        WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2;
      `, [testYear, testClass])
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.students 
        WHERE admission_no LIKE 'CS-TEST-%' OR admission_no LIKE 'ADM-2083-11MGT-19%';
      `)

      // 1. Seed dummy students and enrollments with ZERO practical logs
      const s1 = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no) VALUES ('Dummy One', '${tag}-D1') RETURNING id;
      `)
      const s2 = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no) VALUES ('Dummy Two', '${tag}-D2') RETURNING id;
      `)
      const s1Id = s1.rows[0].id
      const s2Id = s2.rows[0].id

      const enr1 = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ('${testYear}', '${testClass}', '${s1Id}', 191, 'active')
        RETURNING id;
      `)
      const enr2 = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ('${testYear}', '${testClass}', '${s2Id}', 192, 'active')
        RETURNING id;
      `)
      const enr1Id = enr1.rows[0].id
      const enr2Id = enr2.rows[0].id

      // Seed dummy CAD seat plan on workstation ws-01 if available
      const wsCheck = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.workstations WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1;`)
      if (wsCheck.rows.length > 0) {
        const wsId = wsCheck.rows[0].id
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (academic_year_id, class_id, enrollment_id, workstation_id, lab_id)
          VALUES ('${testYear}', '${testClass}', '${enr1Id}', '${wsId}', 'comp');
        `)
      }

      // 2. Perform Clean Slate Ingestion with fresh real students (Rolls 191..193)
      const cleanSlatePayload = [
        { roll_number: 191, full_name: 'Real Student Alpha', admission_no: null, registration_no: null },
        { roll_number: 192, full_name: 'Real Student Beta', admission_no: null, registration_no: null },
        { roll_number: 193, full_name: 'Real Student Gamma', admission_no: null, registration_no: null },
      ]

      const commitRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
          $1,
          $2,
          $3::jsonb,
          'clean_slate'
        ) as result;
      `, [testYear, testClass, JSON.stringify(cleanSlatePayload)])

      const result = commitRes.rows[0].result
      assert.equal(result.success, true)
      assert.equal(result.mode, 'clean_slate')
      assert.equal(result.processed_rows, 3)
      assert.equal(result.enrollments_created, 3)

      // 3. Verify old dummy seat plans are wiped
      const seatCheck = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) as count FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
        WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2;
      `, [testYear, testClass])
      assert.equal(Number(seatCheck.rows[0].count), 0, 'Clean slate must wipe old seat plans')

      // 4. Verify orphaned dummy students were cleanly deleted
      const dummyCheck = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) as count FROM public.students
        WHERE id IN ($1, $2);
      `, [s1Id, s2Id])
      assert.equal(Number(dummyCheck.rows[0].count), 0, 'Clean slate must delete orphaned dummy students')

      // 5. Verify incoming students have standard auto-generated admission numbers
      const newEnrolls = await client.query(`
        SELECT se.roll_number, s.full_name, s.admission_no
        FROM public.student_enrollments se
        JOIN public.students s ON s.id = se.student_id
        WHERE se.academic_year_id = $1 AND se.class_id = $2
        ORDER BY se.roll_number ASC;
      `, [testYear, testClass])

      assert.equal(newEnrolls.rows.length, 3)
      assert.equal(newEnrolls.rows[0].full_name, 'Real Student Alpha')
      assert.equal(newEnrolls.rows[0].admission_no, 'ADM-2083-11MGT-191')
      assert.equal(newEnrolls.rows[1].admission_no, 'ADM-2083-11MGT-192')
      assert.equal(newEnrolls.rows[2].admission_no, 'ADM-2083-11MGT-193')

      // 6. Cleanup test records
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments
        WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2 AND roll_number IN (191, 192, 193);
      `, [testYear, testClass])
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.students
        WHERE admission_no LIKE 'ADM-2083-11MGT-19%';
      `)
    })

    it('Contextual Roll Shift Resolution: Student shifts from Roll 12 to Roll 14 without roll collision', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      const testYear = '2083'
      const testClass = '11mgt'
      const shiftTag = `SHIFT-${Date.now()}`

      // Create student enrolled at Roll 181
      const studentRes = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no) VALUES ('Shifting Student', '${shiftTag}') RETURNING id;
      `)
      const studentId = studentRes.rows[0].id

      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ('${testYear}', '${testClass}', '${studentId}', 181, 'active');
      `)

      // Sync import with roll updated to 182
      const shiftPayload = [
        { roll_number: 182, full_name: 'Shifting Student', admission_no: shiftTag, registration_no: null },
      ]

      const shiftRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
          $1,
          $2,
          $3::jsonb,
          'sync'
        ) as result;
      `, [testYear, testClass, JSON.stringify(shiftPayload)])

      const res = shiftRes.rows[0].result
      assert.equal(res.success, true)
      assert.equal(res.enrollments_updated, 1, 'Roll shifted cleanly from 181 to 182')

      const verifyRoll = await client.query(`
        SELECT roll_number FROM public.student_enrollments
        WHERE student_id = $1 AND academic_year_id = $2 AND class_id = $3;
      `, [studentId, testYear, testClass])

      assert.equal(verifyRoll.rows[0].roll_number, 182)

      // Cleanup
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id = $1;`, [studentId])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [studentId])
    })
  })
})

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

// 1. Load environment variables from .env.local
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const k = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const v = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[k]) process.env[k] = v
    }
  }
}

process.env.NODE_ENV = 'test'

const dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL
assert.ok(dbUrl, 'DATABASE_URL must be defined in .env.local for roster lifecycle integration tests')

test('Phase 6: Unified Roster Lifecycle, Archival & Governance Test Suite', async (t) => {
  const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
  const client = await pool.connect()

      is_active: true,

    })

    client.release()

  })

  // =========================================================================
  // SUBTEST 1: getStudentsByClass Status Filtering & Derived Workstation Fields
  // =========================================================================
  await t.test('1. getStudentsByClass: Multi-status segmentation & derived workstation metadata', async () => {
    setAdminUser()

    const activeRes = await getStudentsByClass({
      classId: '12eng',
      academicYearId: '2083',
      statusFilter: 'active',
    })

    assert.equal(activeRes.success, true, 'getStudentsByClass active succeeded')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(activeRes.data), 'Returns array of students')
    assert.ok(activeRes.data.length > 0, 'Class 12 Eng has active students')

    for (const student of activeRes.data) {
      assert.equal(student.enrollment_status, 'active', 'Student enrollment status must be active')
      assert.ok('assigned_workstation_label' in student, 'Includes assigned_workstation_label property')
      assert.ok('is_unseated' in student, 'Includes is_unseated boolean property')
      if (student.assigned_workstation_label) {
        assert.equal(student.is_unseated, false, 'Seated student has is_unseated === false')
      } else {
        assert.equal(student.is_unseated, true, 'Unseated student has is_unseated === true')
      }
    }

    const allRes = await getStudentsByClass({
      classId: '12eng',
      academicYearId: '2083',
      statusFilter: 'all',
    })

    assert.equal(allRes.success, true, 'getStudentsByClass all succeeded')
    assert.ok(allRes.data.length >= activeRes.data.length, 'All filter returns >= active count')
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // SUBTEST 2: restoreStudentEnrollmentAction & Auto-Collision Resolution
  // =========================================================================
  await t.test('2. restoreStudentEnrollmentAction: Enforces permissions and auto-resolves roll collision', async () => {
    // 2a. Reject unprivileged access
    setTeacherUser()
    const unprivRes = await restoreStudentEnrollmentAction('some-enrollment-id')
    assert.equal(unprivRes.success, false, 'Unprivileged teacher call rejected')
    assert.match(unprivRes.error || '', /Access denied: Only administrators can restore archived students/i)

    // Setup clean test cohort in 11mgt
    setAdminUser()
    const testYear = '2083'
    const testClass = '11mgt'
    const studentIdA = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
    const studentIdB = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'

    try {
      // Clean previous 11mgt enrollments to ensure clean slate for roll calculation
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans WHERE class_id = $1 AND academic_year_id = $2;`, [testClass, testYear])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE class_id = $1 AND academic_year_id = $2;`, [testClass, testYear])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [studentIdA, studentIdB])

      // Seed Student A (Active at Roll 15) & Student B (Archived at Roll 14)
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active)
        VALUES 
          ($1, 'TEST-RESTORE-A', 'Bikash Tamang', true),
          ($2, 'TEST-RESTORE-B', 'Deepak Shrestha', false);
      `, [studentIdA, studentIdB])

      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 15, 'active');
      `, [testYear, testClass, studentIdA])

      const enrB = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 14, 'archived')
        RETURNING id;
      `, [testYear, testClass, studentIdB])

      const enrollmentBId = enrB.rows[0].id

      // 2b. Restore Student B requesting Roll 15 (which is currently occupied by Student A)
      // The restore action detects Roll 15 is occupied in 11mgt, auto-assigns next available roll (15 + 1 = 16)
      const restoreRes = await restoreStudentEnrollmentAction(enrollmentBId, 15)
      assert.equal(restoreRes.success, true, `Restore should succeed: ${restoreRes.error}`)
      assert.equal(restoreRes.newRollNumber, 16, 'Auto-assigned next available roll (15 + 1 = 16)')

      // Verify Student B enrollment in DB is active at Roll 16
      const checkEnr = await client.query(`SELECT roll_number, status FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id = $1;`, [enrollmentBId])
      assert.equal(checkEnr.rows[0]?.status, 'active', 'Enrollment is active')
      assert.equal(checkEnr.rows[0]?.roll_number, 16, 'Roll is 16')

      // Verify Student B person record is reactivated
      const checkStd = await client.query(`SELECT is_active FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [studentIdB])
      assert.equal(checkStd.rows[0]?.is_active, true, 'Student person record is marked is_active = true')

    } finally {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id IN ($1, $2);`, [studentIdA, studentIdB])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [studentIdA, studentIdB])
    }
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // SUBTEST 3: resequenceClassRollsAlphabeticallyAction Guards & Execution
  // =========================================================================
  await t.test('3. resequenceClassRollsAlphabeticallyAction: Guards logbook integrity & sorts A-Z', async () => {
    // 3a. Rejects unprivileged caller
    setTeacherUser()
    const unprivRes = await resequenceClassRollsAlphabeticallyAction({ classId: '12eng', academicYearId: '2083' })
    assert.equal(unprivRes.success, false, 'Unprivileged resequence rejected')
    assert.match(unprivRes.error || '', /Access denied: Only administrators can resequence roll numbers/i)

    setAdminUser()

    // 3b. Strictly blocks resequencing when practical attendance logs exist (e.g., 12eng has 105 logs)
    const blockedRes = await resequenceClassRollsAlphabeticallyAction({ classId: '12eng', academicYearId: '2083' })
    assert.equal(blockedRes.success, false, 'Blocked resequence when practical attendance logs exist')
    assert.match(
      blockedRes.error || '',
      /Cannot resequence roll numbers: .* practical attendance record\(s\) already exist for this class/i
    )

    // 3c. Clean resequencing execution for 0-log cohort
    const testYear = '2083'
    const testClass = '11mgt'
    const s1 = 'c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
    const s2 = 'c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'
    const s3 = 'c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'

    try {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2;`, [testYear, testClass])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2, $3);`, [s1, s2, s3])

      // Seed students in reverse alphabetical order
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active)
        VALUES 
          ($1, 'TEST-SEQ-1', 'Zoya Thapa', true),
          ($2, 'TEST-SEQ-2', 'Anil Regmi', true),
          ($3, 'TEST-SEQ-3', 'Manoj Dahal', true);
      `, [s1, s2, s3])

      // Assign non-alphabetical initial rolls:
      // Zoya (s1) -> Roll 1
      // Anil (s2) -> Roll 2
      // Manoj (s3) -> Roll 3
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES 
          ($1, $2, $3, 1, 'active'),
          ($1, $2, $4, 2, 'active'),
          ($1, $2, $5, 3, 'active');
      `, [testYear, testClass, s1, s2, s3])

      // Execute alphabetical resequence
      const seqRes = await resequenceClassRollsAlphabeticallyAction({
        classId: testClass,
        academicYearId: testYear,
      })

      assert.equal(seqRes.success, true, `Resequence should succeed: ${seqRes.error}`)
      assert.equal(seqRes.count, 3, 'Resequenced 3 active students')

      // Verify sorted order A-Z:
      // Anil Regmi -> Roll 1
      // Manoj Dahal -> Roll 2
      // Zoya Thapa -> Roll 3
      const enrCheck = await client.query(`
        SELECT se.roll_number, s.full_name
        FROM public.student_enrollments se
        JOIN public.students s ON s.id = se.student_id
        WHERE se.student_id IN ($1, $2, $3)
        ORDER BY se.roll_number ASC;
      `, [s1, s2, s3])

      assert.equal(enrCheck.rows[0]?.full_name, 'Anil Regmi')
      assert.equal(enrCheck.rows[0]?.roll_number, 1)

      assert.equal(enrCheck.rows[1]?.full_name, 'Manoj Dahal')
      assert.equal(enrCheck.rows[1]?.roll_number, 2)

      assert.equal(enrCheck.rows[2]?.full_name, 'Zoya Thapa')
      assert.equal(enrCheck.rows[2]?.roll_number, 3)

    } finally {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id IN ($1, $2, $3);`, [s1, s2, s3])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2, $3);`, [s1, s2, s3])
    }
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // SUBTEST 4: updateStudentDetailsAction Friendly Collision Handling
  // =========================================================================
  await t.test('4. updateStudentDetailsAction: Pre-save duplicate roll & admission guards', async () => {
    setAdminUser()
    const testYear = '2083'
    const testClass = '11mgt'
    const s1 = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
    const s2 = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'

    try {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2;`, [testYear, testClass])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])

      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active)
        VALUES 
          ($1, 'TEST-ADM-COLL-1', 'Gaurav Karki', true),
          ($2, 'TEST-ADM-COLL-2', 'Nabin Bhatta', true);
      `, [s1, s2])

      const enr1Res = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 10, 'active')
        RETURNING id;
      `, [testYear, testClass, s1])

      const enr2Res = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 11, 'active')
        RETURNING id;
      `, [testYear, testClass, s2])

      const enr2Id = enr2Res.rows[0].id

      // 4a. Attempt to change Student 2's roll to Roll 10 (already held by Gaurav Karki)
      const rollCollRes = await updateStudentDetailsAction({
        studentId: s2,
        enrollmentId: enr2Id,
        fullName: 'Nabin Bhatta',
        rollNumber: 10,
        admissionNo: 'TEST-ADM-COLL-2',
      })

      assert.equal(rollCollRes.success, false, 'Roll collision rejected')
      assert.match(
        rollCollRes.error || '',
        /Roll 10 is already occupied by Gaurav Karki\. Please choose an unassigned roll number\./i
      )

      // 4b. Attempt to assign Student 1's admission number to Student 2
      const admCollRes = await updateStudentDetailsAction({
        studentId: s2,
        enrollmentId: enr2Id,
        fullName: 'Nabin Bhatta',
        rollNumber: 11,
        admissionNo: 'TEST-ADM-COLL-1',
      })

      assert.equal(admCollRes.success, false, 'Duplicate admission number rejected')
      assert.match(
        admCollRes.error || '',
        /Admission number "TEST-ADM-COLL-1" is already assigned to Gaurav Karki\./i
      )

      // 4c. Valid update succeeds
      const validRes = await updateStudentDetailsAction({
        studentId: s2,
        enrollmentId: enr2Id,
        fullName: 'Nabin Bhatta (Updated)',
        rollNumber: 12,
        admissionNo: 'TEST-ADM-COLL-2-UPDATED',
        gender: 'male',
      })

      assert.equal(validRes.success, true, `Valid update succeeds: ${validRes.error}`)

      const verifyRow = await client.query(`SELECT full_name, admission_no FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [s2])
      assert.equal(verifyRow.rows[0]?.full_name, 'Nabin Bhatta (Updated)')
      assert.equal(verifyRow.rows[0]?.admission_no, 'TEST-ADM-COLL-2-UPDATED')

    } finally {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])
    }
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // SUBTEST 5: wipeClassCohortDataAction Danger Zone Execution & Receipt
  // =========================================================================
  await t.test('5. wipeClassCohortDataAction: Danger zone access guard & atomic cohort purge', async () => {
    // 5a. Access guard: rejects non-super_admin

      classId: '11mgt',
      academicYearId: '2083',

    setAdminUser()

    const mismatchRes = await wipeClassCohortDataAction({
      classId: '11mgt',
      academicYearId: '2083',
      confirmPhrase: 'DELETE PLEASE',
    })
    assert.equal(mismatchRes.success, false, 'Confirmation phrase mismatch rejected')
    assert.match(mismatchRes.error || '', /Confirmation phrase mismatch/i)

    // 5c. Atomic wipe execution on test class cohort
    const testYear = '2083'
    const testClass = '11mgt'
    const s1 = 'e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
    const s2 = 'e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'

    try {
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans 
        WHERE enrollment_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2);
      `, [testYear, testClass])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2;`, [testYear, testClass])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])

      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active)
        VALUES 
          ($1, 'TEST-WIPE-1', 'Purge Candidate 1', true),
          ($2, 'TEST-WIPE-2', 'Purge Candidate 2', true);
      `, [s1, s2])

      const enr1Res = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 101, 'active')
        RETURNING id;
      `, [testYear, testClass, s1])

      const enr2Res = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 102, 'active')
        RETURNING id;
      `, [testYear, testClass, s2])

      const enr1Id = enr1Res.rows[0].id

      // Seed dummy seat plan
      const wsCheck = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.workstations WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1;`)
      if (wsCheck.rows.length > 0) {
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (academic_year_id, class_id, enrollment_id, workstation_id, lab_id)
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'comp');
        `, [testYear, testClass, enr1Id, wsCheck.rows[0].id])
      }

      // Execute wipe action with exact confirmation phrase
      const wipeRes = await wipeClassCohortDataAction({
        classId: testClass,
        academicYearId: testYear,
        confirmPhrase: `WIPE ${testClass.toUpperCase()}`,
        reason: 'Automated Test Suite Verification',
      })

      assert.equal(wipeRes.success, true, `Wipe should succeed: ${wipeRes.error}`)
      assert.ok(wipeRes.receipt, 'Returns receipt object')
      assert.ok(wipeRes.receipt.enrollmentsDeleted >= 2, 'Deleted at least 2 test enrollments')
      assert.ok(wipeRes.receipt.studentsDeleted >= 2, 'Deleted orphaned test students')

      // Verify enrollments are purged from DB
      const enrCheck = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) FROM public.student_enrollments 
        WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2;
      `, [testYear, testClass])
      assert.equal(parseInt(enrCheck.rows[0].count), 0, 'Zero enrollments remain for this class')

      // Verify orphaned test students are deleted
      const stdCheck = await client.query(`SELECT count(*) FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])
      assert.equal(parseInt(stdCheck.rows[0].count), 0, 'Orphaned test students completely removed')

      // Verify audit log entry exists in public.audit_logs
      const auditCheck = await client.query(`
        SELECT action, entity_type, entity_label 
        FROM public.audit_logs 
        WHERE metadata->>'action' = 'WIPE_CLASS_COHORT'
        ORDER BY created_at DESC 
        LIMIT 1;
      `)
      assert.equal(auditCheck.rows.length, 1, 'Audit log entry was recorded')
      assert.equal(auditCheck.rows[0]?.action, 'DELETE')
      assert.equal(auditCheck.rows[0]?.entity_type, 'roster')

    } finally {
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans 
        WHERE enrollment_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id IN ($1, $2));
      `, [s1, s2])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])
    }

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { parsePhotoFilename, doNamesMatch, matchPhotosToStudents } from '../lib/student-photos/matcher.ts';

test('Student Photo Filename Parser & Two-Factor Matcher Suite', async (t) => {
  await t.test('1. parsePhotoFilename correctly extracts roll and candidate names', () => {
    const res1 = parsePhotoFilename('8_kaustuv_thapa.jpg');
    assert.equal(res1.extractedRoll, 8);
    assert.equal(res1.extractedNameCandidate, 'kaustuv thapa');
    assert.equal(res1.extension, 'jpg');

    const res2 = parsePhotoFilename('08-kaustuv-thapa.png');
    assert.equal(res2.extractedRoll, 8);
    assert.equal(res2.extractedNameCandidate, 'kaustuv thapa');
    assert.equal(res2.extension, 'png');

    const res3 = parsePhotoFilename('14 aarav sharma.jpeg');
    assert.equal(res3.extractedRoll, 14);
    assert.equal(res3.extractedNameCandidate, 'aarav sharma');

    const res4 = parsePhotoFilename('8.jpg');
    assert.equal(res4.extractedRoll, 8);
    assert.equal(res4.extractedNameCandidate, null);

    const res5 = parsePhotoFilename('kaustuv_thapa.webp');
    assert.equal(res5.extractedRoll, null);
    assert.equal(res5.extractedNameCandidate, 'kaustuv thapa');
  });

  await t.test('2. doNamesMatch identifies normalized token overlaps', () => {
    assert.equal(doNamesMatch('kaustuv thapa', 'Kaustuv Thapa'), true);
    assert.equal(doNamesMatch('kaustuv thapa', 'Kaustav Thapa'), true); // surname match
    assert.equal(doNamesMatch('aarav sharma', 'Bibek Karki'), false);
  });

  await t.test('3. matchPhotosToStudents assigns high confidence on exact roll + name match', () => {
    const mockStudents = [
      { student_id: 's-1', roll_number: 8, full_name: 'Kaustuv Thapa', admission_no: 'ADM-008', registration_no: null },
      { student_id: 's-2', roll_number: 14, full_name: 'Aarav Sharma', admission_no: 'ADM-014', registration_no: null },
      { student_id: 's-3', roll_number: 22, full_name: 'Dipen Gurung', admission_no: '1641052469', registration_no: null },
    ];

    // Mock File object
    const mockFiles = [
      { name: '8_kaustuv_thapa.jpg' },
      { name: '14.jpg' },
      { name: '1641052469.png' },
      { name: '99_unknown_student.jpg' },
    ];

    // Node mock URL.createObjectURL
    globalThis.URL = globalThis.URL || {};
    if (!globalThis.URL.createObjectURL) {
      globalThis.URL.createObjectURL = () => 'blob:mock-url';
    }

    const matches = matchPhotosToStudents(mockFiles, mockStudents);
    assert.equal(matches.length, 4);

    // File 1: 8_kaustuv_thapa.jpg
    assert.equal(matches[0].matchedStudentId, 's-1');
    assert.equal(matches[0].confidence, 'high');
    assert.match(matches[0].matchReason, /Roll 8 \+ Name Verified/);

    // File 2: 14.jpg
    assert.equal(matches[1].matchedStudentId, 's-2');
    assert.equal(matches[1].confidence, 'high');

    // File 3: 1641052469.png (RFID)
    assert.equal(matches[2].matchedStudentId, 's-3');
    assert.equal(matches[2].confidence, 'high');

    // File 4: Unmatched
    assert.equal(matches[3].matchedStudentId, null);
    assert.equal(matches[3].confidence, 'unmatched');
  });
});

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'
import { loginAsAdmin } from './helpers/auth'

test.describe('Academic Terminology, Design Invariants & Standards Audit Suite', () => {
  const routes = ['/computer-lab', '/terminal/PC-01', '/login']

  test('1. Standardized Academic Terminology Compliance (Zero Forbidden Jargon)', async ({ page }) => {
    for (const route of routes) {
      await page.goto(route)
      await page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded')

      const bodyText = await page.locator('body').innerText()

      // Invariant 1: Must use "Attendance" - NEVER "Turnout" or "Turnout Tally"
      expect(bodyText).not.toMatch(/\bTurnout\b/i)
      expect(bodyText).not.toMatch(/\bTurnout Tally\b/i)

      // Invariant 2: Must use "Timetable" or "Schedule" - NEVER "Matrix"
      expect(bodyText).not.toMatch(/\bToday's Matrix\b/i)
      expect(bodyText).not.toMatch(/\bRoutine Matrix\b/i)

      // Invariant 3: Must use "Equipment" - NEVER "Apparatus" (Universal Equipment Standard)
      expect(bodyText).not.toMatch(/\bApparatus\b/i)
      expect(bodyText).not.toMatch(/\bBurnt Apparatus\b/i)
    }
  })

  test('2. Super Admin Console (/admin): Safety Lock "Precaution Active" Verification', async ({ page }) => {
    await loginAsAdmin(page)
    await page.goto('/admin')
    await page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded')

    // Verify "Precaution Active" safety toggle label is present intact (Rule #3)
    const precautionLabel = page.locator('text=/Precaution Active/i').first()
    if (await precautionLabel.count() > 0) {
      await expect(precautionLabel).toBeVisible()
    }
  })

  test('3. Official A4 Printable Documents & Signature Blocks', async ({ page }) => {
    await loginAsAdmin(page)

    // A. Official Practical Records Sheet
    await page.goto('/print/records')
    await page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded')
    await expect(page.locator('body')).not.toContainText('Internal Server Error')
    await expect(page.locator('body')).toContainText(/Teacher|Instructor|In-Charge|Signature/i)

    // B. Wall Seating Chart Sheet
    await page.goto('/print/seating-chart')
    await page.waitForLoadState('domcontentloaded')
